Add the black beans and season with cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, turn off the heat.
Peel the mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh and transfer to a bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir ½ of the cilantro into the beans (save the rest for the dressing).
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Add the remaining cilantro, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the lime juice; whisk together.
Divide the rice between bowls, then add the black bean and pepper mixture, mango, and drizzle with the cilantro-lime dressing. Mix together and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Penne Pasta with Mixed Vegetables
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and return to pot; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel the carrot and onion. Slice carrot into ¼-inch rounds; slice onion in half and then into thin half moons. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies to the skillet along with the garlic and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crisp tender, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, small dice the tomato and grate the Parmesean.
Shave leaves off the stems of the parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, stir in the beans, diced tomatoes, half the parsley, oil, capers, and red wine vinegar; cook an additional 2 minutes. Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.
Transfer vegetable mixture to the pot with the pasta and toss gently to combine.
To serve, divide the pasta mixture between plates and top with Parmesean and remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Pineapple Hawaiian Pita Pizza
instructions: Peel and slice the onion into thin half rings.
Wash and dry the pineapple. Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince garlic.
In a medium bowl, combine garlic, tomato sauce, and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil.
Grate the mozzarella.
To assemble, top the pitas with a thin layer of tomato sauce, cheese, red onion, pineapple, and black beans. Place on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove from oven and top with cilantro leaves. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Potato, Zucchini & Corn Soup in Creamy Coconut Broth
ingredients: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and medium dice carrot and potato; place both in a small bowl.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the carrot and potato.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and medium dice zucchini.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
When the veggies are soft, add beans, zucchini, thyme, broth, coconut milk, and corn to the pan. Stir to combine the soup, cover, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the soup is simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Juice lemon into the soup and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Purée & Fried Eggs with Avocado & Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the onion.
Drain and rinse the beans.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the beans and broth to the saucepan; bring to a boil, then mash the beans with a hand blender or potato masher. Remove from the heat and cover to keep warm.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, halve the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs and transfer to a plate.
While the eggs cook, halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
To serve, divide the bean purée, eggs, and tomato-avocado mixture among plates; season with salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Sandwich (Torta) with Blistered Jalapeños & Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Add to the baking sheet with the onions. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Drizzle onions and jalapeños with oil and season with salt; toss to coat. Place in the oven and broil, tossing once, until veggies are soft and blistered, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. (Keep the broiler on.)
Meanwhile, juice lime into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and grate the carrot. Add carrot and broccoli slaw to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw; set aside.
Drain and rinse beans; transfer to another medium bowl.
Add spices to the bowl with the beans. Crush with a fork or potato masher until almost smooth, with some texture remaining; set aside.
Grate cheese.

Remove broiled veggies to a small bowl. Split rolls in half and place, cut-side up, on the baking sheet. Spread bean mash over the bottom halves of the rolls and top with cheese. Place in the oven and broil until buns are lightly toasted, and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, thinly slice tomato. Halve and pit the avocado; slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out.
Place the bottom of each roll on a plate. Top with tomato, avocado, onions, and jalapeños; close sandwich with top half of the roll. Serve with broccoli slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Soup with Feta & Kale, Apple & Pecan Salad
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and add to the bell pepper.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the bell pepper and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the broth and beans (with their liquid) to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
In a medium salad bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
Cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add the kale to the salad bowl and, using your hands, massage the dressing into the leaves.
Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Roughly chop the pecans and add to the salad bowl. Toss the salad to combine.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until the desired consistently is reached. Alternatively, mash the beans with a potato masher.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and garnish with feta. Serve with the kale salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Soup with Orange, Avocado & Red Onion Salad
ingredients: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice ½ of the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the pepper, then thinly slice the other ½ into quarter-rings and transfer to a small bowl.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the broth and beans (with their liquid) to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
While the soup cooks, using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.

Cut a small piece off both orange ends to reveal the flesh; place the orange on one end and, from top to bottom, slice off the skin and pith. Halve the orange lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds and transfer to a small bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out.
Juice the lime into a small bowl (that will be used to make the dressing).
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until the desired consistently is reached.

To serve, divide the soup between bowls, top with spoonfuls of Greek yogurt, and garnish with some of the cilantro. Arrange the orange slices, avocado, and remaining onion on plates. Drizzle the salad with the dressing and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Sweet Potato, Bell Pepper & Onion Bake with Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; place in a medium bowl.
Peel and cut sweet potato into ½-inch cubes; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden brown and fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and flour; whisk until combined, about 1 minute.
Add broth and spices to the pan; cook, whisking frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Add mozzarella and yogurt to the pan; whisk until cheese is melted and combined. Cover sauce and set over low heat, stirring occasionally, to keep warm.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven, add beans, and stir to combine. Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and beans between bowls; top with cheese sauce and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Tacos with Pico de Gallo & Feta
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl (that will hold the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add ½ of the onion to the salsa bowl and leave the rest on the cutting board.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the remaining onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, juice the lime and add to the salsa bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Add the black beans to the skillet and season with chili powder, salt, and pepper; cook until the mixture is heated through, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
To serve, divide the black beans between the tortillas, then top with the salsa and feta. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Tacos with Tomato & Avocado Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh. Add to the tomatoes.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add ½ of the cilantro to the bowl with the tomatoes and avocado and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Transfer ½ of the onion to the bowl with the salsa ingredients and leave the rest on the cutting board.
Once the skillet is heated, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the remaining onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, drain and rinse the black beans in a colander.
Add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the beans and remaining cilantro.

Season the bean mixture with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are warmed through, 2 to 4 minutes. Mash some of the beans with a fork is desired.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp towel and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Juice the lime; drizzle ½ of the lime juice over the beans and add the rest to the bowl with the salsa ingredients.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; mix together.
To serve, place the bean mixture into the tortillas and top with the salsa. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Veggie Quesadillas with Tomato & Avocado Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry tomatoes, jalapeño, and cilantro.

Medium dice and transfer tomatoes to a medium bowl. Seed, mince, and add ½ of the jalapeño to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Halve and pit avocado; scoop out the flesh, medium dice, and add to bowl. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Peel, small dice onion, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling).
Drizzle ingredients in bowl with olive oil and lime juice; season with salt and pepper. Mix to combine and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining onion, jalapeño, and bell pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
Add beans and remaining cilantro to skillet. Then season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Grate 1 cup of cheddar.
Wash and dry skillet. Heat over medium heat.
Place tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ¼ of the cheese, ½ of the bean mixture, and another ¼ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over to close.
Coat skillet with oil. Place both quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges.
To serve, place quesadilla on a plate and serve with salsa. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean-Zucchini Quesadilla with Zingy Greens & Lime Crema
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice onion into half moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, chili powder, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander.

Add beans and tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the beans are warm and the sauce has reduced, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and wipe the skillet clean with paper towels.
Meanwhile, trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to the colander and sprinkle with salt. Set the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl; add yogurt, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the crema and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Place grated zucchini in the middle of a clean towel, bring the corners together, and squeeze out excess moisture.
To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide beans, zucchini, and cheese between them, arranging it on one half of the tortilla; fold in half to close.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, and spices in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad and crema on the side. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Glazed Drumsticks with Couscous & Roasted Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Combine blackberries, water, vinegar, and sugar in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, mashing berries occasionally with a spoon, until liquid begins to thicken and berries break down, 5-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken drumsticks dry with a paper towel and place on a large baking sheet pan; season with salt and pepper.
Add butter and mustard to the saucepan; stir to combine until butter has melted. Transfer half the glaze to a small bowl and set aside.
Coat all sides of the drumsticks with the remaining glaze. Place in the oven and roast, flipping once, until the chicken is cooked through, 30-35 minutes.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; place in a large bowl.

Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the sprouts. Toss to combine and spread out in a single layer on the sheet pan with the chicken. Return to oven and roast until the sprouts are tender and chicken is cooked through, 15 minutes more.
Meanwhile, rinse and wipe out the small saucepan with a clean towel. Return to medium-high heat.
Add broth and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add half of the parsley to the pan with the couscous and stir to combine.
To serve, divide couscous, Brussels sprouts, and chicken between plates. Pour reserved glaze over the chicken. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Blackened Salmon with Cajun-Spiced Beans, Rice & Tomato Relish
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season salmon with half of the spice mix on both sides. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the beans.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3-4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add both to the bowl with the garlic and onion.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and remaining spice mix; sauté until soft, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, small dice tomato and transfer to the reserved bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the relish and set aside.
Add water and tomato paste to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add beans and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide rice and beans between plates; top with blackened salmon and tomato relish. Enjoy!

name: Blackened Tilapia with Minty Zucchini Mango Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim ends, peel, and small dice zucchini. Small dice tomato. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Peel the mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the large bowl.
Seed the bell pepper, small dice, and transfer to the large bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice the lime over the veggies; add oil and spices and toss until well coated. Set aside in fridge until ready to serve.
In a small bowl, combine the spices for the fish.
Using paper towel, pat the fillets dry, then rub with spice mixture on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the fillets to the skillet and cook, 3 minutes per side, until opaque and cooked through.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with blackened tilapia. Enjoy!

name: "BLT" Macaroni Salad with Crispy Bacon, Tomato, Lettuce & Bread Crumbs
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl and set aside.

When the bacon is done, remove all but 2 teaspoons of drippings from the skillet, then return to medium heat. Add bread crumbs and toast, stirring often, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add garlic powder and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Stir to combine the macaroni salad.
Separate lettuce into leaves and arrange on plates. Top with macaroni salad, bread crumbs, and crispy bacon. Enjoy!

name: Blue Cheese Burger with Cherry-Cranberry Sauce & Lemony Kale
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Place cherries, cranberries, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

Once boiling, gently crush the fruit with the back of a spoon to release juices. Reduce heat to a simmer and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl. Use your hands to massage the dressing into the kale until slightly softened; set aside.
Form the ground beef into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and season with spices.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, place patties in the pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Place bottom half of a bun on each plate, then top with burgers, blue cheese, and cherry sauce. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Brazilian Seafood Stew (Moqueca) with Shrimp, Cod, Bell Pepper & Lime
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lime into a medium bowl. (Reserve lime for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lime zest along with chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the marinade.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; add to the bowl with the marinade.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces; add to the bowl and gently stir to coat. Set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; place in another medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, medium dice tomatoes.

Add tomatoes and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add marinated seafood and coconut milk to the pan; stir to combine, return to a simmer, and continue to cook until seafood is cooked through, 1 minute more.
When the stew is done, juice reserved lime into the pan, add cilantro, and gently stir to combine; remove from heat.
To serve, divide seafood stew between bowls and enjoy!

name: Bread Salad (Panzanella) with Tuna, Tomatoes, Mozzarella & Olives
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Add the cooled croutons and capers to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the salad.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Breadcrumb Crusted Halibut with Mushroom-Spinach Sauté & Quinoa
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, bread crumbs, dill, salt, and pepper.
Place halibut in a small baking dish. Drizzle with a little olive oil and top with bread crumb mixture, patting lightly to help it adhere.
Place dish in the oven and bake until fish is white and flaky, 10-12 minutes. Change setting to broil and continue baking until bread crumb mixture turns golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry spinach. Add to mushrooms and toss until just wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate, add spinach-mushroom sauté, and top with halibut fillet. Enjoy!

name: Breaded Pork Chop with Curry Roasted Cauliflower & Apple-Raisin Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with curry powder and salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until cauliflower is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels, place on a plate, and spread both sides with mayo. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over both sides and press to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; cut into matchsticks or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with raisins, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chops, cauliflower, and apple salad between plates; enjoy!

name: British-Style Sausage with Mashed Potatoes, Onion Gravy & Kale Salad
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until golden, about 5 minutes (the sausages will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the sausages cook, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and cook, stirring constantly, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over onion and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.

Stir in broth and spices, then bring gravy to a simmer. Once simmering, return sausages to the skillet, reduce heat to low, and cover with a lid; cook, turning sausages occasionally, until gravy has thickened and sausages are cooked through, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add butter, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm.
Place vinegar, water, Dijon, and salt in medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage the dressing into the kale.
Halve tomatoes, add to the bowl with the kale, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide mashed potatoes between plates, then top with sausages and gravy. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Broccoli, Apple & Bacon Salad with Walnuts
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash broccoli, carrot, and apple; set aside.
Place bacon in skillet and cook until crispy and golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, mayo, honey, salt, and pepper.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stem into smaller pieces; add to bowl with dressing. Trim, peel, and coarsely grate carrot; add to bowl. Core and medium dice apple; add to bowl.
Add cranberries to bowl. Roughly chop walnuts and add to bowl.
Chop bacon into small pieces and add to salad. Toss salad until well coated with dressing.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Chickpea Salad with Feta & Zesty Lemon Dressing
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash broccoli, separate into bite-sized florets, and cut thick stems into smaller pieces.
Once water is boiling, add broccoli to saucepan and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 1-2 minutes. Drain and run under cold water. Set aside to drain excess water.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash lemon and grate 1 tsp of zest. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon zest and juice, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Rinse and drain chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and dry bell pepper and parsley. Seed and medium dice the pepper. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
Add broccoli and feta to bowl. Toss salad.
To serve, place salad on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Cheddar Frittata
instructions: Peel and small dice the onion. Wash the broccoli and chop into bite-size florets.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar into a small bowl and set aside.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and lightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, water, ½ of the shredded cheddar, salt, and pepper.
Add more butter to the skillet followed by broccoli florets. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes.
Preheat broiler and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Spread out the broccoli evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli Pork Egg Fu Young with Steamed Rice & Gravy
ingredients: 10 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Combine broth, soy sauce, vinegar, and oil in a small saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.

Combine additional broth and corn starch in a small bowl; whisk to combine a smooth slurry. When broth in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then cover and reduce heat to low; simmer the gravy for 30 minutes.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to another small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Remove casing from sausage and roughly chop.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.

When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Once done, transfer sausage to a small bowl, leaving sausage drippings in the skillet. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Slice mushrooms. Peel and thinly slice yellow onion into half rings.
Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Return skillet to stove over high heat and add more oil. Add the vegetables and salt; cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Crack eggs into a medium bowl; add vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.

Stir sausage back into the skillet with the veggies. Reduce heat to medium-high and pour egg mixture evenly over the top. Let cook, undisturbed, until the bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 4-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Place skillet in the oven and cook until top is set and golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide rice and egg fu young between dishes. Pour gravy over the egg fu young and top with green onions. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Chicken Thighs & Mushrooms with Creamy Zucchini-Parmesan Rice
ingredients: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, salt, and garlic powder to the pan; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
While the broth is heating, trim and coarsely grate the zucchini.

Once the broth comes to a boil, add zucchini and stir the mixture; cover the saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook zucchini-rice until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan.
Halve mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the chicken.
Drizzle chicken and mushrooms with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping the chicken halfway through, until chicken and mushrooms are golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the zucchini-rice is done, add chives and Parmesan to the pan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken, mushrooms, and zucchini-chive rice between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Greek Cod & Avocado Cucumber Salad with Feta-Mint Dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half the lime into a small bowl. (Reserve remaining lime for later.)
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Mince the sun-dried tomatoes; add to the bowl along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the tapenade.
Thinly slice olives.
Pat cod dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet; season with salt and pepper. Spread with tapenade and top with olives.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until the cod is almost cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lime into a medium bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Remove cod from the oven and top with half the feta (reserve remaining cheese for the salad). Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until the fish flakes easily with a fork and the cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise; add to the salad bowl along with the reserved feta. Gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cod and salad between plates; enjoy!

name: Broiled Lemon Cod with Bean, Corn, Cucumber, Cilantro & Feta Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Pat fish dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet; drizzle with half of the dressing and turn to coat. (Set remaining dressing aside for the salad.)
Place fish in the oven and broil until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Place corn in the colander, run under hot water (from the tap) to defrost, and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the feta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide fish and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Parmesan Tilapia with Sautéed Broccoli, Zucchini & Pine Nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup), coat with thin layer of oil, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the broccoli and set aside.
Juice lemon into a small bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo and spices; stir to combine and set aside.
Pat tilapia dry with paper towels, place on the baking sheet, and drizzle with oil. Place fish in the oven and broil until almost cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli, zucchini, pine nuts, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender-crisp, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.

When the fish is almost cooked through, remove from the oven. Spread the mayo mixture over the fillets. Return to the oven and continue to broil until topping is browned and fish is cooked through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide fish and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Pork Chop with Green Beans, Peppers, Tahini Yogurt & Almonds
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Place pan in the oven. Broil, flipping halfway through, until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place yogurt, tahini, vinegar, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, and trim green beans; place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper, then slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the green beans.
Return the skillet to high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chops and tahini yogurt between plates; top yogurt with veggies and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Pork Chops with Sautéed Red Cabbage
instructions: Heat oven on broiler setting and position rack about 15 cm from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan (or baking dish if you don’t have a broiler pan) and season both sides with chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Place dish in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through cooking time, until chops are cooked through and browned at the edges, 10-12 minutes.
Wash, core, and cut apple into thin bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large bowl.
Wash cabbage, halve, and cut off core. Thinly slice crosswise into shreds and add to bowl with apple.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add cabbage, apple, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper to skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender-crisp, 6-8 minutes.
Serve pork chops with cabbage on the side. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Salt & Pepper Pork Chops with Cauliflower "Potato Salad"
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets.
Once the water comes to a boil, uncover, add cauliflower and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool.
Preheat the broiler to high and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with salt and pepper.

Place pork chops in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through cooking time. Cook until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F. Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
While the pork chops are cooking, add mayonnaise, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to a medium bowl; whisk together.
Peel and mince shallot. Small dice celery (reserving celery leaves for garnish); transfer both to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add dill and drained cauliflower to the bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower salad and pork chops between plates. Garnish with celery leaves and enjoy!

name: Brothy Vegetarian Edamame & Potato Succotash with Toasted Flatbread
ingredients: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice potato; transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the potato.
Trim and cut celery crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and spices to the pan; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add veggies, broth, edamame, corn, and sugar to the pan with the onion. Stir to combine the succotash and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the succotash is cooking, halve tomatoes and place in the reserved bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Toast flatbread if desired (optional), then slice into wedges.
When the succotash is done, add tomatoes, parsley, and cream to the pan; stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide succotash between bowls and enjoy with warm flatbread on the side!

name: Brown Butter Pumpkin Mac & Cheese
ingredients: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta and salt, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
While pasta is cooking, melt butter in another medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir, cooking until butter has browned, 3-4 minutes. Watch it carefully so that it does not burn.
Remove saucepan from heat, stir in flour, whisking constantly, 1 minute.
Return saucepan to heat, gradually stir in milk. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Stir in pumpkin, salt, pepper, and most of the thyme (reserve some for garnish).
Grate cheese and add to saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted.
When macaroni is done cooking, drain in a colander. Add to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the macaroni and cheese between plates or bowls and sprinkle with fresh thyme. Enjoy!

name: Brown Sugar-Sage Gnocchi Bake with Sausage, Peppers, Tomatoes & Onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the pepper.
Peel and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Add gnocchi, oil, sugar, and spices to the bowl; toss to combine.
Transfer veggies and gnocchi to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies and gnocchi.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until sausages are cooked through and gnocchi is golden brown, 20-25 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven. Transfer sausages to a cutting board and slice crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces.
To serve, divide gnocchi, veggies, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprout, Grape, Couscous & Goat Cheese Stuffed Acorn Squash
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side down on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
While the squash is cooking, place couscous in a medium bowl.

Pour broth into a skillet, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, pour into the bowl with the couscous, and stir (reserve skillet for later use). Tightly cover the bowl with foil and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, trim and halve Brussels sprouts.
Add Brussels sprouts and water to the skillet; cover with a lid and cook until the sprouts are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve grapes.
When the sprouts are ready, juice lemon into the skillet and add grapes. Continue to cook, uncovered, until most of the liquid has evaporated and grapes are soft, 1-2 minutes more.
Add veggie-grape mixture and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the couscous; stir to combine the stuffing.
To serve, divide squash halves between plates and fill with the veggie-couscous stuffing. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprout Salad with Roasted Chicken, Crisp Apple & Walnuts
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Combine oils, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place in a baking dish, pour half of the dressing over the chicken and turn to coat.
Place chicken in the oven and bake, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the large bowl with the remaining dressing.
Trim ends and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Medium dice celery. Add both to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Core and thinly slice apple.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with apples, walnuts, and chicken. Enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprout Salad with Warm Chickpeas, Beet, Pear & Goat Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice beets. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the baking sheet with the beets, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are golden and beets are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pear. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Just before serving, add pumpkin seeds to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with warm chickpeas and beets. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprouts, Grape & Apple Salad with Walnuts & Parmesan
instructions: In a large salad bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper.
Wash brussels sprouts and trim rough ends. Shred by slicing thinly or using a mandoline slicer; transfer to salad bowl and toss with dressing.
Wash grapes and apple. Halve and add grapes to salad bowl. Core, medium dice, and add apple to salad bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts; add to salad bowl. Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan; add to salad bowl.
Toss salad until well combined.
Serve salad on a plate and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Cauliflower & Chickpea Pita Pockets with Ranch Sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Reserve ¼ cup of the chickpea liquid and place in a medium bowl, then drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Add half the chickpeas to the bowl with the bean liquid and mash well; stir in remaining chickpeas, leaving them whole.
Add vinegar, Dijon, chili-garlic sauce, and tomato paste to the chickpea mixture; stir to combine. Set aside.
To make the ranch dressing, combine mayonnaise and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine. Add additional water (1 tsp at a time) as needed to reach a drizzling consistency.
Remove leaves and thick stems from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets.
Peel and small dice onion and carrot.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add cauliflower, onion, carrot, and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, 3-4 minutes.

Add chickpea mixture, salt, and pepper to the skillet and continue to cook until cauliflower is tender, about 5 minutes. Taste the chickpea mixture and add more garlic-chili sauce (¼ tsp at a time) to reach desired spiciness.
Small dice celery.
Cut pita in half and carefully open the pita pockets.
To serve, divide spinach, bean-cauliflower mixture, and celery between pita pockets. Top with ranch dressing and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Celery Sticks
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the spices. Transfer ¼ tsp of the mixture to a small bowl for garnishing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the chicken thighs into ¼-inch strips. Add the chicken to the spice mixture and mix thoroughly with your hands.
Wash and dry the cutting board.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, halve the tomatoes and transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Place the onions next to the tomatoes.

Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out. Place the avocado slices next to the tomatoes and onions.
Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce; separate the leaves and place on a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery sticks; cut the sticks crosswise into thirds.

To serve, scoop the chicken into the lettuce leaves, then top with the tomatoes, green onions, and avocado slices. Garnish with the remaining spice mix and serve with the celery sticks on the side. Enjoy!

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps with Kale, Carrot, Celery & Blue Cheese Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Place chili-garlic sauce, vinegar, honey, Worcestershire, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the Buffalo sauce.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets; cut each fillet crosswise into 1-inch thick strips.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add chicken and buffalo sauce to the skillet, tossing to coat. Cook, turning strips occasionally, until cooked through; 4-5 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat and set aside. (Reserve sauce bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and grate carrots; add to the bowl with the kale.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Place yogurt, blue cheese, water, Worcestershire, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread with half of the blue cheese dressing. Divide chicken and half of the salad between them; roll tightly to close and cut in half.
Divide wraps between plates. Serve with remaining salad and dressing on the side. Enjoy!

name: Bunless Beef Burgers with Sautéed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, Worcestershire, Dijon, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper; mix well.
Form the beef mixture into 4 patties.
Once the pan / skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the beef patties to the pan / skillet; cook until they are cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the potatoes.
Once the sauté pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the diced potatoes to the pan and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.
Slice the tomato into rounds.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with tomato slices, burger patties, and some mayo. Add the sweet potatoes on the side. Enjoy!

name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Tuna, Potato, Orange, Avocado & Olives
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter potatoes and place in a small saucepan; cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool, then set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add mayo, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Peel orange, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, flake with a fork, and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl, along with the potatoes, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Buttered Scallops with Bacon & Brown Sugar Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the onion.
Once the bacon is cooked, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels; pat to remove excess oil. Crumble or chop into small pieces and set aside.
Return skillet (with bacon fat) to the stove over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally until softened, 3-5 minutes.
Wash, trim ends, and thinly slice Brussels sprouts.
Add the Brussels sprouts, vinegar, sugar, and salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and tender, 4-6 minutes. Once done, transfer to a medium bowl; set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat and add the butter.
Pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Carefully add scallops to the skillet in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
To serve, divide the Brussels sprouts between plates. Top with the scallops and crumbled bacon. Enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash Fettuccine with Bacon & Baby Spinach
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Chop the bacon into small pieces.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.

Add the bacon to the saucepan and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate; remove the saucepan from the heat but leave the bacon fat in the saucepan.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and small dice the onion.
Wash the squash; trim off and discard the ends. Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half; peel and small dice the squash. You should have about 1 ½ cups of diced squash.
Return the saucepan to medium heat. Add the onion, minced garlic, and butternut squash to the bacon fat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
Add broth to pan with squash mixture, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and let simmer, covered, until the squash is fork-tender, 15 minutes.
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Finely grate the Parmesan cheese and set aside.

Once the squash mixture is cooked through, purée with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender. Return the puréed mixture to the saucepan on low heat to keep warm. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add pasta to the saucepan with the squash purée; toss to combine.
Add spinach to the pasta and stir, allowing the spinach to wilt into the pasta, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and top with bacon. Enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash, Prosciutto & Blue Cheese Flatbread with Arugula
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and finely chop the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the sage along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to coat. Transfer squash to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto slices and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, water, and salt. Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Crumble or chop the crispy prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Carefully remove cooked squash from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface.
Arrange flatbreads on the baking sheet; layer with onion, squash, prosciutto, and blue cheese. Place in the oven and bake until flatbreads are golden and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
When the flatbreads are done, remove from oven, and top each with a small handful of arugula. (Reserve remaining arugula for serving.)
Divide flatbreads between plates; serve with remaining arugula on the side and enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash Soup with Spinach Salad & Lemon Poppy Seed Dressing
ingredients: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice the carrot. Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrot, onion, and ginger to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the squash. Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds; peel and small dice the squash. You should have about 4 cups of diced squash.
Add the squash, broth, and spices to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook until squash is fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Juice half of the lemon into a large bowl; add the oil, honey, Dijon, onion powder, and poppy seeds. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Core and medium dice apple.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Add the spinach, feta, walnuts, cranberries, and apple to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine and set aside.
Once the squash is tender, juice remaining lemon into the pot. Add the milk. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
Pureé the soup with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with pumpkin seeds. Serve with the salad and enjoy!

name: Cajun Chicken & Avocado Burger with Baby Spinach Salad
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, prepare cajun rub by mixing together cumin, coriander, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Rub with spice mixture on all sides.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken fillets and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry spinach. Save a small handful of leaves for the burgers; add the rest to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; thinly slice while still in skin and scoop out.
Toast buns on grill/skillet.
To serve, spread some Dijon on buns. Top with remaining spinach leaves, chicken, and slices of tomato and avocado. Serve with spinach salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cajun Chicken, Cheddar & Spinach Salad with Scallion-Yogurt Dressing
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, trim green onions and place on a plate. Drizzle with oil and season with salt.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the green onions. Cook, turning once, until tender and lightly charred, about 5 minutes; return to the plate.

Meanwhile, place yogurt, oil, water, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside. (Add additional water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a drizzling consistency.)
Place spices in another small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with the spice mix on both sides.
Once the green onions are done, return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Add chicken and grill, flipping once, until charred and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, mince the grilled onions and add to the bowl with the dressing. Stir to combine and set aside. (Reserve plate for next step.)
Coarsely grate cheese and place on the reserved plate.
Halve tomatoes and add to the plate with the cheese.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Slice chicken into strips.
Divide spinach between plates or bowls; top with cheese, tomatoes, avocado, and chicken. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!

name: California Club Sandwich with Lemony Spinach Salad
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until it is golden brown and cooked through and bacon until it is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and pat dry the bacon.
Toast buns or rolls.
Wash and dry spinach. Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; cut into slices while still in skin and scoop out.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together mayo with ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad dressing).
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Spread garlic mayo over the bottom halves of bread in each pair. Layer with spinach leaves, chicken, avocado, tomato, and bacon. Top with remaining slices of bread.
Place sandwich on a plate and serve with remaining spinach on the side. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: California Cobb Salad with Dijon Vinaigrette
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
Cut bacon strips in half crosswise.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until golden brown and no longer pink inside, 4-5 minutes per side. Cook bacon until crispy, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer both to a plate lined with paper towels.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash lettuce and chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Wash and halve tomatoes.
Scoop out the avocado flesh and medium dice.
Cut chicken into cubes. Roughly chop bacon. Peel and roughly chop eggs.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate, then add tomatoes, avocado, chicken, bacon, eggs, and blue cheese in rows over top. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Cannellini Beans, Roasted Tomatoes & Basil over Polenta
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.

In a small saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking constantly, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until grains are soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash tomatoes and add to beans.
Peel and mince garlic; add to beans and tomatoes. Drizzle with olive oil and season salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Place in the oven and roast until tomatoes collapse slightly, 10-15 minutes.
Wash basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Add Parmesan, salt, and pepper to polenta and stir to combine. If polenta is too firm, add a little more water and stir.
Remove beans and tomatoes from oven. Sprinkle with basil and drizzle with vinegar; gently toss.
Place polenta into a bowl and top with beans and tomatoes. Enjoy!

name: Caprese Frittata with Fresh Mozzarella & Basil Ribbons
ingredients: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Wash the fresh produce. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons. Slice the tomatoes into rounds. Peel and mince the garlic.
Slice the mozzarella into rounds.
Preheat the broiler and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.

Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Reserve 5 or 6 tomato slices for later while adding the rest to the skillet. Cook until tomatoes begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, water, ½ of the basil ribbons (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm by the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Top frittata with mozzarella and remaining tomato slices. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and garnish with remaining basil ribbons and freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

name: Caprese Pasta Salad with Arugula & Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
To make the dressing, add garlic, shallots, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a small bowl. Whisk to combine; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Halve the grape tomatoes lengthwise and add to a medium bowl.
Cut the fresh mozzarella into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
When pasta is done, drain in a colander, and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside to drain further.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes and mozzarella; reserve the rest for garnish.
Add the pasta to the bowl and toss to combine.
