Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely mince and add to the bowl with the onion. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomato. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with salt, and stir to combine the pico de gallo. Set aside.

In a small saucepan, combine almond milk, oil, nutritional yeast, arrowroot starch, Dijon, onion powder, and garlic powder; whisk until smooth. Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking constantly, until the sauce becomes thick and stretchy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander.
When the rice is done, add beans to the saucepan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and bean mixture between bowls or plates. Top with pico de gallo, avocado, and cheesy sauce. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Vegan Pizza with Mushrooms, Sun-dried Tomatoes & Basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add tomato sauce and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine and set aside.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slice the mushrooms.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.

In a small saucepan, combine almond milk, oil, nutritional yeast, arrowroot starch, Dijon, onion powder, and garlic powder; whisk until smooth. Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking constantly, until the sauce becomes thick and stretchy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Spread tomato sauce over each flatbread. Spoon the cheesy sauce over the tomato sauce, then top with mushrooms, sun-dried tomatoes, and Italian seasoning.
Place prepared flatbreads back in the oven and bake, until mushrooms have softened, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, slice flatbread pizzas into wedges and divide between plates. Garnish with basil and enjoy!

name: Cheesy White Bean & Kale Skillet with Toast Points
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise, slice off stems, and finely chop leaves.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Grate cheese and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale, garlic, and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, until kale softens, 2-3 minutes.

Add beans, hot water (from the tap), and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then sprinkle with cheese and place in the oven; broil until cheese has melted and is browned in spots, 3-4 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, cut bread slices on the diagonal and place on a baking sheet pan in a single layer; drizzle with oil on both sides.
Place bread in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until nicely toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Divide white bean mixture between plates or bowls. Serve with toast for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Zucchini Noodle Lasagna Skillet
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince or press garlic.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add ground beef and garlic. Break apart the beef with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until beef is browned, 4-6 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and broth. Increase the heat to high and bring to a rapid simmer.

Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Put some of the fresh herbs aside to use as garnish.
Add the parsley, basil, spinach, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook for another 4-5 minutes.
Trim ends of the zucchini. Using a vegetable peeler, peel zucchini into thick noodle-like strips.

Remove the tomato sauce from the skillet, and set aside in a bowl. Arrange the half of the zucchini in a flat layer that covers the bottom of the skillet. Pour half of the tomato mixture over top of the zucchini noodles. Then arrange a second layer of zucchini noodles, followed by a second layer of sauce.
Thinly slice the mozzarella cheese. Finely grate the Parmesan cheese.
Cover the top layer of sauce with the mozzarella slices and sprinkle with Parmesan, place in the oven for 10-12 minutes. Put the oven to broil for the last few minutes to brown the top if desired.
Divide between plates, garnish with remaining fresh herbs, and enjoy!

name: Cherry Tomato & Garlic Shrimp Sauté with Cornmeal Drop Biscuits
ingredients: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder, sugar, and salt; stir to combine.

Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly. Add the milk and stir to combine.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, drop portions of batter onto a baking sheet pan, spacing them 2-inches apart. Place in the oven and bake until lightly golden, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Transfer shrimp to a plate and season with salt and pepper on both sides; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Halve tomatoes crosswise.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, tomatoes, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until tomatoes have softened, about 2 minutes.
Add shrimp to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and opaque, about 4 minutes. Juice lemon into the skillet and stir to combine; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide shrimp and biscuits between bowls or plates and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Apple & Squash Skillet over Couscous with Spinach Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle with flour, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and slice apple into wedges; add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim and peel squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and medium dice; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the veggies and apple (reserve remaining parsley for garnish).

Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, parsley, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, place vinegar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

When the veggies and apple are soft, add broth, vinegar, honey, and Dijon to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple and squash are tender, 4-5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
Return chicken to the skillet with the veggies and apple; continue to cook, turning the chicken occasionally, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide couscous, chicken skillet, and salad between plates. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Chicken-Bacon Succotash with Corn, Peas, Tomatoes & Parsley
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.

Return skillet to medium-high heat; add chicken and stir-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the chicken to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the skillet.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat; once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, corn, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and starting to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise.
Add tomatoes and peas to the skillet, stirring to combine the succotash; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 4 minutes.
While the succotash is cooking, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Chop or crumble bacon into pieces.
Return chicken (with any accumulated juices), bacon, and parsley to the skillet (reserving a small handful of parsley for garnish). Stir to combine and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
To serve, divide succotash between plates or bowls. Top with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Cashew Stir-Fry over Rice
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger. Peel and mince garlic.
Place soy sauce, oil, cornstarch, vinegar, and sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Seed and medium dice bell peppers.
Cut chicken thighs into ½-inch pieces.
Heat a large skillet over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add ginger, garlic, and bell peppers; continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 more minutes.
Pour sauce into the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-high and cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions on a clean cutting board and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Add cashews to the skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with chicken stir-fry and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole & Butter Lettuce
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a medium bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets, then thinly slice fillets crosswise into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
After chicken has been transferred add more oil to skillet. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry lettuce.
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges.
Return chicken and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
To serve, fill lettuce leaves with fajita mix. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a small bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets, then thinly slice fillets crosswise into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges.
Add chicken and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place tortillas on a plate and fill with fajita filling. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Goat Cheese Panini with Arugula Tomato Salad
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat grill/skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash, seed, and cut bell pepper into short strips.
Return grill/skillet to stove. Add pepper and cook until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to plate with chicken.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the spread by mashing together garlic, goat cheese, vinegar, and oregano.
Slice buns/rolls in half.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.

Spread ¼ of the goat cheese mixture onto each of the 4 bun/roll halves. Top bottom halves with a few arugula leaves, chicken, and ½ of the bell pepper (save the rest for the salad). Close with top halves.

Place sandwiches on grill/skillet and carefully flatten using a panini press or something heavy. Cook until browned and crispy on the bottom, 1-2 minutes. Carefully flip and continue cooking until browned on the other side, another 1-2 minutes.
In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry arugula and tomato. Cut the tomato into thin wedges. Add arugula, tomato, and remaining bell pepper to bowl with dressing. Toss salad.
To serve, cut panini in half and place on a plate with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Pico de Gallo
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Peel and mince onion. Wash, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Wash and dry tomatoes, jalapeno, and cilantro. Small dice tomatoes. Seed and mince jalapeño. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a small bowl, prepare salsa by mixing together the tomatoes, ½ of the onion, ½ of the jalapeño, ½ of the cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally into thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Return skillet to stove. Add more oil, bell pepper, and remaining onion, jalapeño, and cilantro. Season with cumin, salt, and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to plate with chicken.
Slice chicken crosswise into strips.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of cheddar.

Place tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ¼ of the cheese, ½ of the chicken and vegetable mixture, and top with another ¼ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over so they are closed.
Wipe skillet with paper towel and reduce heat to medium. Add oil and swirl to coat.

Place both quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges.
To serve, place quesadilla on a plate and serve with salsa. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Brussels Sprouts & Apple Salad with Toasted Walnuts & Cranberries
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Roughly chop the walnuts.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add the walnuts to the skillet and toast, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Wipe out the pan.

Once the walnuts have been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and place the chicken breasts in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate.

While the chicken cooks, trim off and discard the stems ends of the Brussels sprouts, then remove the outer layer of leaves; halve the sprouts lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds and add to the salad bowl.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the Brussels sprouts and shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer back to the salad bowl.
While the sprouts cook, quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; large dice the apple into ¾-inch cubes and transfer to the salad bowl.
Add the toasted walnuts and dried cranberries to the salad bowl.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
When cool enough to handle, large dice the chicken breasts into ¾-inch cubes. Add to the salad bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Caesar Salad with Yogurt Dressing & Garlic Croutons
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cube bread and transfer to a sheet pan.
Peel and press or mince garlic. Drizzle bread with oil and sprinkle with ¾ of the garlic (save the rest for dressing), parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and bake until golden brown and crispy, 8-10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.

In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, 2 tbsp of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), yogurt, lemon juice, oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.
Cut remaining ¼ lemon into wedges. Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate and top with chicken and croutons. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with remaining Parmesan, and serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Cauliflower Fried 'Rice' with Carrots & Peas
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Rice (grate) using a hand grater or in a food processor.
Wash carrot and green onions.
Trim ends, peel, and small dice carrot; transfer to a medium bowl. Trim ends and slice green onions on the diagonal into ¼ inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
Measure out peas and add to bowl with carrot.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince ginger. Transfer both to a small bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cube chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and stir-fry until browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add more oil to skillet followed by garlic and ginger. Stir fry until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add carrot and peas; stir-fry until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice, mix well, and stir-fry until tender, 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk egg.
Move all the ingredients to one side of the skillet and pour egg on the other side. Scramble egg and mix with everything else.
Return chicken to skillet and add soy sauce and green onions; stir to combine.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu with Lemon-Dijon Sauce & Roasted Asparagus
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Place on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Place baking sheet in the bottom half of the oven and bake until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat broiler on high, leaving the asparagus in the bottom of the oven until it is finished cooking.
Place flour in a shallow dish; lightly dredge the chicken in the flour, shake off excess, and place on a plate.
Wash and juice the lemon into a small bowl. Add broth, Dijon, and flour; whisk until smooth.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add breaded cutlets to the skillet and cook until lightly golden, about 2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, slice the cheese.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add broth mixture and whisk, scraping up the browned bits, until mixture thickens slightly, about 1 minute.

Return the cutlets to the skillet. Place two slices of prosciutto on each cutlet and top with cheese. Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden and chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken cutlets, sauce, and asparagus between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Cutlets with Lemony Brussels Sprout, Cranberry & Walnut Sauté
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, sprinkle flour over both sides of each cutlet and press gently to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot and garlic.
When the chicken is done, remove to a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shallot and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add Brussels sprouts, broth, cranberries, and salt to the skillet; cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until Brussels sprouts are fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the bowl used for the Brussels sprouts.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the parsley.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Uncover the skillet, then add the parsley, lemon juice, and walnuts. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
To serve, divide chicken and Brussels sprout sauté between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Drumsticks with Spicy Maple-Roasted Cauliflower & Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Place chicken in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and golden, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place maple syrup, oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and paprika in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Cut off leaves from the cauliflower, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the sauce.
Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Transfer veggies to a baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Add baking dish to the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; top with green onions and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Eggplant & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Creamy Basil Salad
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and small dice eggplant.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until meat is crumbly and eggplant has softened, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Add mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the basil. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens and half of the feta. Toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining feta for the next step.)
When the chicken and eggplant are done, add remaining feta to the skillet. Stir to combine the filling and remove from heat.
Divide peppers between plates, stuff with chicken filling, and top with reserved basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Fingers & Avocado Dip with Greens & Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk the egg in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl, mix together the almond meal, shredded coconut, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Cut the chicken into strips.
Dip the chicken strips into the egg, then transfer to the dry mixture and turn to coat. Shake off excess and place on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil.
Place in the oven and bake until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocado; cut the flesh into cubes while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic. Add the garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper to the avocado. Mash with a fork until very smooth.
Wash the mixed greens and tomatoes.
To serve, place chicken strips on a plate and arrange greens and tomatoes on the side. Drizzle the greens with a little olive oil. Serve with avocado dip and enjoy!

name: Chicken Florentine Pasta with Mushrooms, Grape Tomatoes & Spinach
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain once cooked.
Wash and dry spinach. Wash tomatoes and mushrooms. Halve the tomatoes. Quarter the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

Return skillet to stove, reduce heat to medium, and add more oil (if needed). Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook until tender, 3-4 minutes.
Grate or shave ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Add broth and cook until reduced by about ½. Remove pan from heat.
Return chicken to skillet and add tomatoes, spinach, and pasta. Toss until ingredients are mixed and spinach is wilted.
To serve, place pasta on a plate or in a bowl and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Fresh Mozzarella Sandwich with Avocado & Spinach Salad
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; thinly slice ½ (save the rest for the salad) while still in skin and scoop out.
Slice mozzarella into rounds.
Place buns or rolls, cut side up, on a sheet pan. Top the bottom halves with avocado slices, chicken, tomato slices, and mozzarella. Leave the top halves as is so they get crusty.
Place in the oven and broil until cheese melts, 3-4 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by combining garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, and remaining avocado. Mash together until smooth.
Wash and dry spinach. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, place sandwiches on a plate and have with spinach salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Green Apple Curry with Basmati Rice
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the sauté pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Cut into 1-inch pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the pan; cook, tossing occasionally, until the pieces are browned but not fully cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer the chicken to a bowl and set aside.
While the chicken cooks, wash and dry the cutting board. Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the onion. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Quarter the apples lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; large dice the apples into ¾-inch cubes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic and curry powder to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the apples to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 1 to 2 minutes.

Return the chicken to the pan and pour in the broth; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the apples are tender, 4 to 6 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the curry. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Green Bean Casserole with Mushrooms & Thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Add to boiling water. Cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash and slice mushrooms. Transfer everything to a plate.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in skillet. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Melt more butter in skillet. Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms. Stirring occasionally, cook until vegetables are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan. In a small bowl, mix together bread crumbs and Parmesan. Set aside.
Wash thyme and slide leaves off the stems.
Sprinkle flour over top vegetables; stir and cook for about 1 minute. Add thyme, chicken, yogurt, salt, and pepper to skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
Transfer mixture to a small baking dish, add green beans, and stir to combine. Sprinkle with parmesan mixture over top.
Place in the oven and cook for 10 minutes. Then broil for 1-2 minutes until topping is slightly browned.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Kale & Cauliflower Skillet with Melty Mozzarella
instructions: Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the cauliflower.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add cauliflower, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower has softened, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in the reserved bowl.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, cut into bite-sized pieces, and season with salt and pepper.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Return cooked veggies to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Using a clean cutting board, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
Return veggies to the skillet and add cream cheese; cook, stirring occasionally, until cream cheese is melted and everything is warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Top skillet with mozzarella and place in the oven; broil until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and veggie skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Kale, Grapefruit & Mint Salad with Thai Peanut Dressing
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off skin and white pith from grapefruit. Slice between the membranes to release segments, transfer to a small bowl, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl, along with oil, peanut butter, vinegar, honey, fish sauce, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the chicken and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side; remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the kale and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop peanuts.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with grapefruit segments, grilled chicken, and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Kebabs with Greek Salad & Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Peel and mince the garlic.
In a small bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Cube the chicken and transfer to a medium bowl. Pour half of the dressing over top (save the rest for the salad) and toss to coat.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread the chicken onto 2 skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Add the chicken to the grill or skillet and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Finely dice ¼ of the cucumber. Peel and mince the remaining garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the tzatziki sauce by mixing together the cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, yogurt, and salt.

Chop the lettuce crosswise into 1 inch strips; transfer to a salad bowl. Quarter the remaining cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into chunks; add to the bowl. Halve the tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Add the olives, feta, and reserved dressing to the salad and toss.
To serve, place salad on a plate and add a chicken skewer on top. Serve with tzatziki sauce and enjoy!

name: Chicken Kofta over Turmeric Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Raita
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and mince onion. Place half in a medium bowl and half in a small bowl (set small bowl aside for the raita).
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the medium bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix until well combined.
Using a ¼-cup measure, form the chicken mixture into 6 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 4-inches long; place kofta on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kofta and pan-fry, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the small bowl that was set aside for the raita.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomato; add to the bowl.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the raita.
To serve, divide rice, kofta, and raita between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Korma with Cauliflower Rice
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
instructions: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, cut into bite-sized (1-inch) pieces, and set aside.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince (or press) garlic.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Wash, peel, and mince or grate ginger.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onions, garlic, and ginger; cook, stirring constantly until onions are softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the spices and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds.
Add canned tomatoes, chicken, salt, and pepper; stir until well combined. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to medium, cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Wash the cauliflower and remove the leaves. Using a food processor or box grater, grate to rice-like texture.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and cook, stirring occasionally, 5 to 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, add the heavy cream and almond flour to the chicken mixture. Uncover and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Set some cilantro aside to use as garnish.
When cooked, remove the cauliflower from the heat, add remaining cilantro, salt, and pepper and stir to combine.
To serve, place cauliflower rice on a plate and top with chicken korma. Garnish with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Chicken with Lemon Dill-Artichoke Sauce, Roasted Potatoes & Broccoli
ingredients: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

When the potatoes are starting to soften, remove from the oven. Add broccoli, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, zest and juice lemon into the reserved skillet.

Add broth, cream, and garlic powder to the skillet with the lemon; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-7 minutes.
While the sauce is cooking, drain and roughly chop artichokes. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the artichokes.
When the sauce has thickened, add artichokes and dill, then stir to combine. Continue to cook until warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Spoon sauce over chicken and enjoy!

name: Chicken Milanese & Italian Pizzeria Salad with Creamy Oregano Dressing
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Place flour and bread crumbs onto two separate plates. Season each plate with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Dredge chicken fillets in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the egg drip off, then dredge the chicken fillets in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Set aside on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken to the skillet; cook until it is cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Once chicken is done, remove from skillet and place on a paper-towel lined plate.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together mayonnaise, vinegar, oil, and oregano.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice the bell pepper and add to the salad bowl.
Trim the ends of the cucumber; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice into half-moons. Add cucumbers to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide the chicken and salad between plates. Top with grated Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Chicken & Mushroom Alfredo over Zucchini Pasta
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash the zucchini and mushrooms. Trim the zucchini ends and using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler) peel into noodle-like sticks; transfer to a large bowl. Thinly slice the mushrooms; transfer to a small bowl. Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in the sauté pan and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.
Once the chicken has been removed, melt remaining butter in the sauté pan. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add the cream and bring to a simmer. Stir in the cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add the zucchini noodles to the sauce and gently toss until well coated.
Slice the chicken crosswise on an angle.
To serve, place fettuccine alfredo in a bowl or on a plate, top with chicken, and garnish with freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Mushroom & Green Pea Skillet with Quinoa
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the mushrooms.
Measure out the green peas and transfer to a bowl.
Pat dry the chicken; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the shallot and mushrooms to the skillet. Season with salt and black pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms have softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the broth and vinegar to the skillet; let the liquid simmer for 1 to 2 minutes.
Place the chicken back in the skillet and cook until it is cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the peas and half of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir until well combined.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
Divide the quinoa between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container) and top each with the chicken and vegetables. Sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chicken with Mustard Cream Sauce & Spinach Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add butter to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince shallot.
Once chicken has been transferred, reduce heat to medium. Add more butter and shallot; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth and vinegar; scrape skillet to loosen any browned bits. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is reduced by about half, 4-5 minutes.
Add Dijon and butter; stir until well combined and continue cooking for 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and freshly ground pepper.
Wash and dry spinach.
To serve, arrange spinach and chicken on a plate; drizzle with mustard sauce and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Peach & Spinach Salad with Feta & Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Transfer the spinach to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown on the outside and cooked through in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Add feta to the salad bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with the chicken strips. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Pineapple & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Creamy Spinach Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Divide pineapple between two medium bowls.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to one of the bowls with the pineapple (set the other bowl of pineapple aside for the salad).
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; add to the bowl with the pineapple and bell pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pineapple, veggies, chicken, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies have softened and chicken is cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into the bowl with the remaining pineapple.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, maple syrup, chili powder, and salt. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide chicken and veggie filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, add spinach to the bowl with the pineapple and dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Pot Pie with Parmesan Potato Crust
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice potato, using a mandoline or knife, into very thin rounds. Coat the bottom of a baking sheet pan with oil. Add potatoes in a single layer, and bake until tender; 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice the carrot. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and discard ends of the celery; small dice and add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion. Add to the bowl.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add carrots, celery, onion, and spices to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, while you prep the chicken.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the pan with the vegetables. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
Add peas, corn, and flour, stirring to coat. Add broth and Worcestershire sauce; bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Carefully pour chicken and vegetable mixture into a small baking dish and use tongs to top with the sliced, par-baked, potatoes. Cover potatoes evenly with Parmesan.

Place in the oven and bake for 6 minutes, then increase oven temperature to broil on high. Broil for 2-3 minutes or until bubbly and potato topping is golden brown. Remove from oven and let rest 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide pot pie between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Kale, Pickled Radish & Lemon-Tahini Sauce
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, toss to combine, and set aside to marinate.
Peel and mince garlic; place in another small bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add tahini, water, oil, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; transfer to a plate.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the plate with the carrot.
Roughly chop pistachios.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls; top with chicken, carrots, kale, pickled radish, and pistachios. Drizzle with lemon-tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Chicken-Rice "Paella" Bake with Bell Pepper, Asparagus & Artichoke
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper and asparagus; set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Reserve skillet with juices for later use.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and rice; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 2 minutes.

Once the veggies are soft, add broth, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, return chicken (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet and nestle into the veggies and rice; cover the skillet with an ovenproof lid or aluminum foil.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until rice has fully absorbed liquid and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Slice lemon into wedges.
When the chicken and rice are done, add artichokes and half of the parsley to the skillet; stir to combine the "paella." (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
To serve, divide paella between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved parsley and squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Salad with Kale, Roasted Squash, Goat Cheese & Walnuts
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, trim, and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Wash and dry kale. Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl.
Once the squash is cool, add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Satay Bowl with Peanut-Zucchini Noodles, Cucumber & Tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Place both in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for garnish).
Juice lime into the bowl. Add peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the sauce.

Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels, cut into bite-sized pieces, and place on the baking sheet. Spoon half of the sauce over the chicken, toss to coat, and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining sauce for later.)
Place chicken in the oven and bake until golden brown and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim zucchini ends and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and remaining sauce; cook, stirring constantly, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Trim and large dice cucumber. Large dice tomato; set both aside on a plate.
Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles between bowls; top with chicken, veggies, peanuts, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Satay with Creamy Peanut Sauce & Thai Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel and mince ginger. In a medium bowl, whisk together ginger, peanut butter, water, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, turmeric, and crushed red pepper. Transfer ½ of mixture to a small bowl (to use as sauce) and set aside.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ (save the rest for the salad) to the medium bowl.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to medium bowl and toss to coat.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread chicken onto 6 skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add skewers and cook until chicken is cooked through but still juicy, 3-4 minutes per side.
In a medium bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining cilantro, lime juice, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper.
Peel and thinly slice onion. Wash, trim ends, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice cucumbers into half rounds. Add everything to bowl with dressing and toss.
To serve, place chicken skewers on a plate, add salad, and have with peanut sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Sautéed Kale with Roasted Beet & Orange Slices
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Heat the oven to 500°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim the ends and peel the beets; slice crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick rounds. Transfer to a baking sheet.
Halve the orange crosswise. Slice one half into rounds and add to the beets. Juice the other half into a bowl and set aside for later.
Drizzle the beet and orange slices with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Place the sheet in the oven and roast until the beet slices are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Fold the kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Roughly chop the leaves and transfer to a medium bowl. Cut the stems into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a separate bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until it is browned and cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add more olive oil to the skillet. Then add the kale stems and season with a little salt; cook until they begin to soften, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and stir with the kale stems until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the kale leaves and pour in the orange juice. Season with more salt and pepper. Stir well and cook until the leaves wilt, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Divide the chicken, beet and orange slices, and the kale sauté between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: Chicken Skewers with Roasted Strawberry, Arugula, Basil & Feta Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Transfer to a small baking dish, drizzle with honey, and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until strawberries are soft, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a medium bowl (reserve lemon for later use). Add mayo and spices to the bowl, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice half of the reserved lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, pepper, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining lemon for serving.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl along with arugula, cooled strawberries, and feta. Gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide skewers and salad between plates. Squeeze reserved lemon over the skewers and enjoy!

name: Chicken "Smash Burger" Tacos with Cheese, Tomato & Special Sauce
instructions: Place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in a small bowl. Stir to combine the special sauce and set aside.
Place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and slice shallot crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place chicken in another medium bowl along with oil, Worcestershire, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.

Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the chicken mixture between them (about 1 ½ tablespoons per tortilla). Using your hands, spread the chicken mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, coarsely grate cheese.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the chicken is cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Flip tacos, chicken-side up, and sprinkle with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese has melted, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, and halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide tacos between plates. Top each with a small handful of salad and drizzle with special sauce. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Soba Noodle Salad with Edamame, Cilantro & Peanut Dressing
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.

Place chicken, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan and cover with water by 1-inch; bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes; transfer chicken to a plate to cool.
Meanwhile, fill another medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add noodles and edamame; cook noodles according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water; set aside.

While the noodles and edamame cook, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, oil, peanut butter, and honey; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Once the chicken is cool, shred using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Add to the bowl along with noodles and edamame.
Roughly chop peanuts and add to the bowl; toss to combine the noodle salad.
To serve, divide noodle salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Chicken Stew (Cacciatore) with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Olives & Quinoa
ingredients: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic; set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle with cornstarch and season with spices on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes. (The chicken will not be cooked all the way through.)
Add veggies and spices to the pan with the chicken; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop olives.

When the veggies are done, add tomatoes, broth, and olives to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until stew has thickened and chicken is cooked through, 6-8 minutes more.
While the stew is simmering, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the stew is done, add half of the basil to the pan; stir to combine and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
To serve, divide quinoa and chicken stew between bowls; top with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Strawberry & Avocado Salad with Spinach & Almonds
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; cut the strawberries into quarters lengthwise and transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocado, then scoop out the flesh and cut crosswise into slices; transfer to the plate with the strawberries.
Measure out the almonds into a small bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper, then rub with olive oil.
Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minute per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
While the chicken cooks, in a small bowl, combine olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper and whisk together.
Slice the chicken crosswise into bite-sized strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of the spinach on a plate and top with the avocado, strawberries, and chicken. Sprinkle with almonds and drizzle with the dressing just before serving. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Stuffed Portobellos with Blue Cheese & Apple-Pecan Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper on both sides; arrange cap-side up.
Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until starting to soften, about 6 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the chicken is cooking, place additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Using tongs, carefully flip the mushrooms, cap-side down. Fill with chicken mixture and top with blue cheese.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until the mushrooms are soft and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pecans, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed mushrooms and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Sweet Potato Curry with Coconut Milk & Spinach
ingredients: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat the sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on the cutting board. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, tossing occasionally, until the onion is softened and the chicken is browned, 5 to 6 minutes.
Wash and dry the cutting board and knife.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
Add the ginger, garlic, curry powder, and turmeric to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the sweet potatoes and coconut milk to the pan; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, cover the pan, and cook until the sweet potatoes are tender, 12 to 15 minutes.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Stir about ¾ of the cilantro into the curry and save the rest for garnishing.
Once the sweet potatoes are tender, add the spinach to the curry and stir until wilted, then remove the curry from the heat.
To serve, spoon the curry into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Tacos with Spicy Mango, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Salsa
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallot and garlic; add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl; add salt and stir to combine the mango salsa. Set aside.
Remove lettuce leaves from head, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with chicken, lettuce, and mango salsa. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Tenders with Honey Mustard Dip & Roasted Green Beans
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk the egg in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl, mix together the almond meal, shredded coconut, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Cut the chicken into strips.
