While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the bowl with the carrots and celery.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion, celery, and carrots to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger.
Add the ginger, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper to the saucepan; stir and cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the pumpkin purée and broth to the saucepan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
While the soup cooks, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip the first step.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a bowl and set aside to cool.
Stir the heavy cream into the soup and season with salt and pepper.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth.
Toast the buns if desired.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with the shrimp. Serve with buns on the side. Enjoy!

name: Gnocchi with Broccoli & Cheddar Cheese Sauce
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add broccoli and gnocchi. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate the cheese and set aside.
When the gnocchi and broccoli are done, drain and return to the saucepan. Cover and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add flour and whisk until smooth. Cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
Slowly pour milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue whisking until the sauce has thickened, 3-4 minutes.
Add cheese and spices to the pan; whisk until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
Pour sauce into the pan with the gnocchi and broccoli; stir to combine.
To serve, divide gnocchi and broccoli between bowls and enjoy!

name: Gnocchi with Creamy Parmesan Tomato Sauce & Vegetables
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water from the tap, cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. Peel and small dice carrots. Small dice zucchini.
Add carrots to the pot and cook until fork-tender, 3-5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add zucchini and gnocchi to the pot with the carrots; boil for 2 minutes more, then drain in a colander and set aside.
Return pot to the stove over medium heat. Add butter and swirl to coat.
Add garlic and flour; whisk until smooth. Gradually add broth; bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer, whisking occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, cream, salt, and pepper.
Add gnocchi and vegetables back to the pot. Cook, stirring often, until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Divide gnocchi between bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Gnocchi with Roasted Grape Tomatoes, Basil, Parmesan & Balsamic
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry grape tomatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel garlic and add to the baking sheet with the tomatoes. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and crushed red pepper; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are burst and browned in spots, 20-25 minutes.
When the tomatoes have about 10 minutes left, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Place half in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to bowl with the Parmesan. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the tomatoes are done, remove from the oven. Add drained gnocchi, Parmesan, basil, and vinegar to the baking sheet. Gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide gnocchi and tomatoes between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and basil, then drizzle with oil. Enjoy!

name: Grape Tomato, Basil & Ricotta Flatbread Pizza with Arugula Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together garlic, oil, salt, and pepper.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
Measure out 1 cup of ricotta.
Place flatbreads on a flat surface. Spoon oil and garlic mixture over top, add tomatoes, and finish off with spoonfuls of ricotta.
Place in the oven, directly on the rack, and bake until cheese melts, 8-10 minutes. Then broil for 1-2 minutes.
Wash and dry arugula and basil. Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Remove pizzas from oven and garnish with basil; slice into wedges.
To serve, place pizza on a plate and have salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Greek Garlic Chicken & Potatoes with Sautéed Lemon Spinach
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick rounds; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the potatoes along with oil and spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place potatoes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake for 6-8 minutes while you prepare the chicken.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).

Remove baking sheet from the oven and place seared chicken on top of the potatoes. Juice half of the lemon over the chicken and potatoes. Return to the oven and continue to bake until potatoes are tender and chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
When there are 5 minutes left on the potatoes and chicken, return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Juice remaining lemon into the skillet and season with salt and pepper; stir to combine.
To serve, divide potatoes, chicken, and spinach between plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Mushroom Burger with Olive Mayo & Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Place on the baking sheet, rub both sides with oil, season with salt and pepper, and arrange gill-side down.
Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until tops are soft, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, mince olives and place in a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the olives (reserve lemon for later use); add mayo and spices. Stir to combine the olive mayo and set aside.

When the tops of the mushrooms are soft, remove from the oven and flip. Fill mushrooms with half the feta (setting remaining feta aside for the dressing), return to the oven, and continue to broil until tender and cheese is golden, 4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
While the mushrooms are cooking, juice reserved lemon into a medium bowl.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl with the lemon juice. Add reserved feta, yogurt, oil, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice half the tomato and add to the bowl. Thinly slice the remaining tomato and set aside for serving.

Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 1 leaf per burger and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl, along with pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread olive mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with feta-stuffed mushrooms, tomato, and reserved lettuce. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide mushroom burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Pita Pizza with Chickpea Spread, Bell Peppers, Tomatoes & Olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, basil, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; place in the reserved bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the chickpeas, then add tahini, oil, and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Halve olives lengthwise.
Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan; evenly top with chickpea spread, then cheese, veggies, and olives.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until pizzas are warmed through and cheese is melted, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Salad Bowl with Tzatziki & Baked Meatballs
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and finely dice the shallot. Peel and mince garlic; add both to the bowl with the parsley.
Add ground beef, egg, almond flour, and spices to the bowl and mix with your hands until well combined.

Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of olive oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the meat mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish. Place the dish in the oven and bake until cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, make the tzatziki. Mince half of the cucumber and transfer to a medium bowl along with the yogurt and salt.
Juice and grate the zest from the lemon into the tzatziki bowl.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the tzatziki and stir to combine.
Halve the remaining cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Halve the tomatoes. Transfer both to a medium salad bowl.
Seed the pepper and slice crosswise to form rings. Peel and slice the remaining shallot into rings. Add both to the salad bowl.
Add feta, olives, oil, and oregano to the salad bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and top with meatballs and tzatziki sauce. Enjoy!

name: Greek Salmon Salad with Tomato, Olives, Yogurt Dressing & Breadsticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Drizzle oil over flatbread, season with spices, and cut into 1½-inch wide strips; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season with spices on the top-side.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
While the salmon is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the dill.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Using a fork or your hands, flake the salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Divide salad between plates or bowls and top with salmon. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!

name: Greek-Style Lentil Salad with Cucumber, Tomatoes, Olives & Feta
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Rinse the lentils, then transfer to a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 2 inches. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook until just tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain in a colander, rinse under cold water, and set aside to cool and drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
In a large salad bowl, combine and whisk together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; halve the onion lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into quarter-rings. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl.
Measure out the feta and transfer to a small bowl.
To serve, divide the salad between bowls or plates and top with the feta. Enjoy!

name: Greek-Style Quinoa & Edamame Salad Bowl with Pita Chips
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.

Place pita on a flat surface. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 2-inch pieces and place on a baking sheet pan.
Zest lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices to the bowl, then stir to combine the herb oil. (Reserve lemon for the salad.)

Spoon herb oil over the pita. Toss pita with your hands, then spread out in an even layer. Transfer to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until the pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the bowl used for the herb oil.

Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice olives and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and small dice shallot; add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl, along with the edamame, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide quinoa, edamame salad, and pita chips between plates or bowls. Top with feta cheese and enjoy!

name: Greek-Style Spaghetti Squash Toss with Chickpeas & Feta
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds; Rub each half with olive oil and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Place halves, cut side down, on a baking sheet.
Place the squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce though the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander, then set aside to drain further.
Halve the tomatoes crosswise and transfer to a medium bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Quarter the olives lengthwise and add to the bowl with the tomatoes and parsley.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic and oregano to the skillet; stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.

Add the chickpeas, spinach, tomatoes, parsley, and olives to the skillet; season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is heated through and the spinach is wilted, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.

Remove the squash from the oven; allow squash to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Using a fork, scrape up the squash flesh to make spaghetti-like strings (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
Add the squash to the vegetable mixture and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the squash and vegetable mixture between plates or bowls and top with the feta cheese. Enjoy!

name: Greek-Style Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Ground Beef
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the zucchini lengthwise, then scrape out and discard the soft flesh from the middle of each half.
Place the zucchini halves cut-side-up on a baking sheet; rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the zucchini halves in the oven and bake while you prepare the filling, 15 to 20 minutes.
Cut the tomato into ¼-inch cubes and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; cut into ¼-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic and oregano to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the ground beef to the skillet and increase the heat to high; season with salt and pepper. Cook the beef, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the beef cooks, halve the olives.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven, change the setting to broil, and place the rack about 6 inches from the top heat source.
Add the tomatoes and olives to the skillet and cook the mixture for an additional 1 to 2 minutes.
Divide the beef filling between the zucchini halves, then sprinkle with feta overtop.
Return the zucchini to the oven and broil until the cheese melts and is lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
To serve, place the zucchini boats on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Greek Turkey Meatball Pita Wraps with Veggies, Olives & Feta Sauce
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.

Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the dill along with turkey, egg, half the feta (reserving the rest for the yogurt sauce), bread crumbs, Dijon, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.
Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the meat mixture into meatballs and place in the baking dish. Place meatballs in the oven and bake until cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the meatballs are baking, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with remaining feta, yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the feta sauce. Set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Slice each pita in half and carefully open them using your fingers.
Divide pita, meatballs, salad, and feta sauce between plates. Fill pitas with fixings and enjoy!

name: Green Bean, Chickpea & Sun-Dried Tomato Salad with Feta & Olives
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the green beans. Trim ends, halve, and transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until lightly charred, 10-15 minutes.
Rinse the chickpeas and set aside to drain.
Peel and mince the garlic. Grate zest from the lemon. In a large bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, lemon zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Wash the tomatoes and parsley. Halve the tomatoes and add to the bowl. Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, chop the leaves, and add to the bowl.
Halve the olives and add to the bowl.
Thinly slice the sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Stir in the chickpeas, green beans, and feta. Toss to coat.
To serve, place salad on a plate and enjoy!

name: Green Bean, Pesto & White Cheddar Grilled Cheese with Mixed Greens
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Finely grate the Parmesan; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the parmesan.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans. Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the beans and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Finely chop the pine nuts.
Add pine nuts, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the Parmesan and stir to combine the pesto; set aside.
Coarsely grate the cheddar.

Divide pesto among bread slices and top half of them with half of the cheddar. Arrange green beans on top of the cheddar so that they all face the same direction. Cover with remaining cheese and close sandwiches; press to secure ingredients.
Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board; slice sandwiches on the diagonal.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Core and thinly slice apple; add apple and mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Apple BBQ Chicken Skewers with Snap Pea, Lime & Radish Salad
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, quarter, and core apple; roughly chop and place in a blender.

Add ketchup, water, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire, and spices to the blender with the apple. Blend on high until BBQ sauce is smooth, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a saucy consistency; set aside.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and slice lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips; thread onto skewers and transfer to a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the chicken directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, coat skewers with half of the sauce. (Reserve remaining sauce for the next step.)
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and coat with remaining sauce.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a medium bowl, then add oil, mayo, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve snap peas; trim and thinly slice radishes. Add both to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide BBQ chicken skewers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Asian Pork Meatballs with Rice & Cucumber-Tomato-Carrot Salad
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the lime juice.
Trim and mince green onions. Add half to the bowl with the lime juice (place remaining green onion in another medium bowl and set aside for the salad).
Add pork, fish sauce, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the lime juice. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the pork mixture into 8 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long; place on a plate.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add meatballs to the pan and grill, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the remaining green onion. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and medium dice cucumber; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice, meatballs, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Brown Sugar-Chili Steak with Cucumber, Pepper & Snap Pea Salad
instructions: Peel and mince garlic; place in a baking dish along with soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat steak dry with paper towels and add to the baking dish with the marinade; turn to coat and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces and add to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Carrot-Zucchini Salad with Cumin Dressing, Couscous & Ricotta
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then halve crosswise; place in a medium bowl.
Trim zucchini and quarter lengthwise, then halve crosswise; add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, drizzle veggies with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.

Once the pan is hot, add the veggies and grill, turning occasionally, until lightly charred and fork-tender, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and let cool, 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into the reserved bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop pistachios and add to the bowl; set aside.
Just before serving, halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with the grilled veggies, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide couscous and grilled veggie salad between plates or bowls; top with ricotta and drizzle with remaining dressing from the bowl. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Greek Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry cucumber, bell pepper, and tomatoes. Medium dice cucumber. Seed and medium dice pepper. Halve tomatoes. Peel and medium dice onion. Add everything to bowl with dressing.
Add olives to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place chicken and greek salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Burger with Peanut Sauce & Crunchy Mint-Veggie Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl; add peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, water, and spices. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, oil, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Add to the bowl with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Place oil, mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add chicken and cook until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Quarter tomatoes. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add both to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread half of the peanut sauce over the bottom half of each bun; top with chicken and remaining sauce. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Burger with Raspberry BBQ Sauce, Asparagus & Peppers
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice orange into a blender.
Peel garlic; add to the blender with the orange juice along with raspberries, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire, and spices. Blend on high until BBQ sauce is very smooth, about 1 minute; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the grill pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim, halve, seed, and slice bell pepper crosswise into 1-inch wide strips; place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges; add to the bowl. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then gently toss to coat.
Once the chicken is done, add veggies to the pan; grill, flipping once, until tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the bowl.
Meanwhile, toast buns if desired.

To assemble the burgers, spread 1 tablespoon of BBQ sauce over the bottom half of each bun; top with chicken and another 1 tablespoon of the sauce. Close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Divide burgers and grilled veggies between plates; serve with remaining sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap with Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

Peel and mince garlic. Grate 1 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the dressing), lemon zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to marinade and toss to coat.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry lettuce. Chop crosswise into 1 inch strips. Transfer to a large bowl.
Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, Parmesan, lemon juice, yogurt, olive oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing into bowl with lettuce and toss to coat.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.

Place tortillas on a flat surface, add lettuce to the middle, and top with chicken. Tightly roll to close. Place on the grill/skillet seam side down and toast until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side.
Slice remaining lemon into wedges. Wash tomatoes.
To serve, place chicken wraps on a plate, add tomatoes on the side, and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Ranch Wraps with Balsamic Tomatoes & Cucumbers
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Pat dry with paper towel and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

When the grill pan or skillet is hot, drizzle with oil and add fillets. Grill until cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side. When the chicken is done, set aside on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Wipe out and reserve pan for use later.
Wash and dry the cucumber and tomato. Cut the tomato into wedges and the cucumber into thin, half moons; set aside.

Add vinegar to a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium-low and continue to simmer, uncovered, until reduced by half, about 5 minutes; remove from heat and set aside.
Combine mayonnaise and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the ranch dressing.
Grate cheese.
Wash and dry spinach. (Skip if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice the cooked chicken into strips.
Lay the tortillas on a flat surface and divide spinach, chicken, grated cheese, and ranch dressing between them. Roll tightly to close.
Return grill pan or regular skillet to medium-high heat.
Place wraps on the grill and cook, rotating every 1-2 minutes, until tortilla is crispy and golden. Cut each wrap in half.
To serve, divide wraps and veggies between plates. Drizzle veggies with balsamic reduction and enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Satay over Rice Noodles with Cucumber & Radish Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of the lime into a small bowl (reserve remaining lime for later use).
Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, fish sauce, water, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the satay sauce.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; place in a medium bowl. Pour half of the satay sauce over the chicken and stir to coat. (Set remaining sauce aside for serving.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice remaining lime into another medium bowl. Add oil, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes into thin rounds; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl with the veggies. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice noodles, salad, and chicken skewers between plates or bowls; drizzle reserved satay sauce over the chicken. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken Skewers with Spicy Plum, Tomato, Corn & Feta Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest half of the lime into a medium bowl (reserve zested half for later use). Cut remaining lime half into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add mayo and spices to the bowl with the lime zest, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lime into a clean medium bowl.

Using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, honey, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Add to the bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add the leaves to the bowl along with feta. Gently stir to combine the salad.
Divide skewers and salad between plates. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Grilled Chicken, Zucchini & Arugula Pasta Salad with Goat Cheese
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the grill pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the chicken and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side; remove from heat and transfer chicken to a plate.
While the chicken cooks, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board, trim and slice zucchini into ½-inch thick planks. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Return the grill pan to medium-high heat; add zucchini and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
When the zucchini is done, remove from the grill pan and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the pasta, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad and sliced chicken between plates. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Grilled Cod with Peach, Tomato & Basil Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the tomatoes lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem ends; cut the halves into thin wedges. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pits; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan / skillet heats up, pat the cod fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place the cod in the grill pan / skillet; cook until it is cooked through and flakes easily, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper; gently toss until well combined.
To serve, divide the fish and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Cod Tacos with Spicy Tomato-Cilantro Salsa & Lettuce
instructions: Place oil and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, add cod to the bowl with the spice paste and turn to coat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add cod and grill until the flesh is opaque and flakey, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a clean medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Add oil, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Separate lettuce leaves, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Use a fork to break the cod into bite-sized pieces.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with grilled cod, salsa, and lettuce. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Curry Chicken with Spicy Apple, Mango & Cucumber Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a medium bowl. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest, along with yogurt and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Add to the bowl with the marinade and, using your hands, toss to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, juice reserved lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide grilled chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Eggplant with Garlic-Tahini Sauce, Pistachios & Chickpea Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and slice eggplant lengthwise into ½-inch thick planks; place on a plate. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add eggplant and grill, flipping once, until lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Juice half of the lemon into a small bowl. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
Add yogurt, water, tahini, sugar, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the tahini sauce and set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, additional tahini, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl, along with chickpeas, and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Roughly chop pistachios.
To serve, divide grilled eggplant and salad between plates. Spoon tahini sauce over eggplant and sprinkle with pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Eggplant Sandwich with Tomato, Goat Cheese & Rosemary Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice potatoes into thin wedges and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the potatoes, along with oil, rosemary, and salt; toss to combine and spread out in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Place potatoes in the oven and bake, tossing once, until tender and golden, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, and cut eggplant into ¼-inch-thick slices. Transfer to the bowl used for the potatoes.
Add oil, vinegar, and salt to the bowl; toss to combine.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add eggplant and grill until tender, flipping once, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, place goat cheese, oil, and Italian seasoning in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Thinly slice tomatoes.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Spread buns evenly with goat cheese. Top the bottom halves with eggplant and tomato, closing with the top half of the bun.
To serve, divide sandwiches and potato wedges between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Fish & Basmati Rice with Strawberry, Cucumber & Mint Salsa
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; cover and bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low and cook the rice until the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the saucepan from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; small dice the strawberries and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; small dice the cucumber and add to the bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Place the fish fillets on a plate and season with salt and pepper, then drizzle with ½ of the lemon juice (save the rest for the salsa) and olive oil.
Place the fish on the grill pan or skillet; cook until the fish is opaque in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
While the fish cooks, add the remaining lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the salsa; mix well.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place the rice and fish on a plate and spoon the salsa over top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Fish Tacos with Spicy Avocado, Grape & Cilantro Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add honey and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl.
Thinly slice grapes and add to the bowl. Stir to combine, then set aside.
Meanwhile, place oil and spices in another medium bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, place tilapia in the bowl with the spice paste and turn to coat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the tilapia and grill until the flesh is opaque and flakey, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the grapes.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salsa.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
Use a fork to break the tilapia into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with grilled tilapia and salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Garlic Shrimp Skewers with "Piña Colada" Coleslaw & Rice
ingredients: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Juice lemon into the bowl, then add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the marinade.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place yogurt, coconut, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread shrimp onto skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the shrimp directly on the pan without using skewers.
Once the pan is hot, add skewers; grill, turning occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and slaw between plates; top with shrimp skewers and enjoy!

name: Grilled Halibut with Cumin Rice & Green Onion-Avocado Salsa
instructions: Peel and mince garlic; place in a small saucepan.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to the saucepan with the garlic. Add water and spices; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Place corn in the colander and run under hot water (from the tap); set aside to drain.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, trim green onions.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add green onions and grill, turning occasionally, until charred and tender, about 5 minutes. Remove to a cutting board to cool slightly.
While the onions are grilling, halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh with a spoon and small dice. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl with the avocado. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Drain tomatoes and add to the bowl along with the corn and spices; stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Pat halibut dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Add halibut and grill, flipping once, until fish flakes easily with a fork, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, chop grilled onions into 1-inch pieces, add to the salsa, and gently stir to combine.
Cut lime into wedges.
To serve, divide rice, salsa, and halibut between plates. Squeeze lime over top and enjoy!

name: Grilled Halibut with Mango-Avocado Salsa & Basmati Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low and cover. Cook the rice until the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the saucepan from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel the mango and cut the flesh away from the pit, starting from the flat sides. Small dice the flesh and transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl with the mango.
Halve the jalapeño and remove the seeds; mince the pepper and add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Place the fish on a plate; season with salt and pepper, then drizzle with olive oil and ½ of the lime juice (save the rest for the salsa).
Place the fish on the grill pan or skillet; cook until it is opaque in the center, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the mango and avocado mixture.
Add the remaining lime juice to the salsa and season with salt and pepper; mix well.
To serve, place the rice and fish on a plate and spoon the mango-avocado salsa on top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Lemon Shrimp Skewers with Peach & Tomato Caprese Salad
ingredients: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place in a medium bowl.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the shrimp. Add oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine and set aside to marinate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; place in another medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice the shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Cut regular tomatoes in half and slice into thick half-moons; halve the grape tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, quarter the peaches (around the pit) and twist to separate, then remove and discard the pits.
Place the peaches on the grill pan and grill until charred, 2 minutes per side. Remove to the bowl with the tomatoes and toss gently to combine the salad.
While the peaches are cooking, thread the shrimp onto skewers. If you don't have skewers you can cook the shrimp directly on the pan. Discard the marinade.
Add the shrimp to the pan and grill until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Tear mozzarella into large chunks with your hands.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide shrimp and Caprese salad between plates. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with basil. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Lime Shrimp with Black Bean, Corn, Pepper, Tomato & Feta Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lime into a medium bowl and set aside for later use. Juice lime into another medium bowl, then add oil, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, then add to the bowl and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Add shrimp to the bowl with the lime zest, season with salt and pepper, then stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread shrimp onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the shrimp directly on the grill pan.)
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers to the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the beans and corn.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide shrimp skewers and salad between plates. Top salad with feta and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach, Strawberry & Arugula Salad with Pistachios & Goat Cheese
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Wash, halve, and pit peaches.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place peaches cut side down on grill/skillet and cook until lightly browned and tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl.
Wash cucumber and strawberries. Medium dice and add cucumber to bowl. Trim stem ends, slice, and add strawberries to bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Slice and add peaches to bowl. Toss salad.
Shell pistachios. Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate, sprinkle goat cheese and pistachios over top, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach-Zucchini Flatbread with Cream Cheese & Balsamic Greens
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. Season the cut-sides with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add zucchini to the pan and grill, flipping once, until charred and just tender, about 10 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pan for later use.)

Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until pitas are slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the pitas are baking, finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Season the cut-sides with salt and pepper.

When the zucchini is done, return the pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Add the peaches and grill, flipping once, until charred and warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove to the plate with the zucchini.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Divide between one small bowl and one medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for the salad.)
Add cream cheese, salt, and pepper to the small bowl with the basil. Using the back of a spoon, mash and combine the cream cheese, then spread evenly over each toasted pita.

Cut grilled zucchini crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Slice grilled peaches lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Divide zucchini and peaches between pitas, arranging in an even layer, then top with Parmesan.
Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until flatbreads are warmed through and cheese is melted, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl with the basil. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Divide flatbreads between plates and top each with a small handful of greens. Serve with remaining greens on the side and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peanut-Lime Chicken with Broccoli, Peppers & Onion
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the garlic. Place in a large bowl.
Juice one lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, and Worcestershire; whisk to combine. Pour half of the marinade into a small bowl and set aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add the chicken to the large bowl with the marinade. Toss to coat and set aside.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Seed and slice the bell pepper into strips.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Coat the grill pan with oil.
Add the broccoli and bell pepper to the grill pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove and set aside on a plate; cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and slice the onion into thick rings.
Add the onion to the grill pan. Cook, flipping once, until the onion starts to soften and grill marks appear, 4-5 minutes. Remove and add to the plate with the veggies. Cover with the foil.
Coat the grill pan with additional oil.
Add the chicken to the grill pan; cook, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 4-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Slice the remaining lime into wedges.
Divide the chicken and veggies between plates; garnish with cilantro and lime wedges and serve with the reserved marinade for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop over Strawberry-Kiwi Spinach Salad with Pistachios
instructions: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, sesame seeds, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice strawberries. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and quarter kiwis lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with sliced pork and enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop with Raw Brussels Sprout, Orange & Avocado Salad
instructions: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of one orange into a medium bowl. Add fish sauce and oil, then stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining oranges for the next step.)
Peel and halve remaining oranges, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim Brussels sprouts, then using a mandoline slicer (optional), shave or very thinly slice the sprouts. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, and stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chops with Peach-Cucumber Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with the spice mixture on both sides.

Place the pork chops in the grill pan / skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Juice the lime and transfer to a large salad bowl.
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Add to the salad bowl and toss the salad to combine.
To serve, divide the pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Tacos with Fresh Peach-Lime Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Combine spices in a small bowl.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and season with spice mixture on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork and cook, flipping occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince leaves. Add to the bowl.

Halve and pit peaches. Add peach halves to the grill pan, cut-side down, and cook until the flesh is soft and charred, about 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board, medium dice, and add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Juice lime into the bowl, season with salt, and stir to combine the salsa.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
Meanwhile, thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with pork and salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Portobello Peanut Satay with Bok Choy, Edamame & Coconut Rice
ingredients: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add coconut milk, water, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice lime into a small bowl.

Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, water, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, turmeric, and curry powder. Whisk to combine the satay sauce.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; medium dice. Place in a medium bowl, add half of the satay sauce, and stir to coat. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread mushrooms onto skewers and place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the mushroom pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, add mushrooms and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred 3-4 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Place oil, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, and soy sauce in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the spicy marinade.
Trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the spicy marinade and gently toss to coat.

When the mushrooms are done, add bok choy to the grill, and cook, flipping once, until tender and charred 3-4 minutes. Once done, add to the plate with the mushrooms. (Reserve any leftover marinade in the bowl for serving.)
To serve, divide coconut rice, bok choy, edamame, and mushroom skewers between plates. Drizzle reserved satay sauce over mushrooms and reserved spicy marinade over bok choy. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Ribeye Steak with Mushrooms & Dijon-Roasted Napa Cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the Dijon sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry cabbage, then trim off and discard the root end. Cut cabbage in half lengthwise to make 2 wedges; transfer to a baking sheet pan, cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning each cabbage wedge onto the other cut-side halfway through, until starting to soften, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the steak into portions, pat dry with paper towels, and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and, using a clean cutting board, thinly slice mushrooms.
When the cabbage is soft, remove baking sheet from the oven and turn wedges once more, so the cut-sides face up; drizzle with Dijon sauce.
Set oven to broil on high and return baking sheet to the oven. Broil until cabbage is golden brown and lightly charred around the edges, about 3 minutes.
When the steak is done, return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, about 4 minutes.
To serve, divide steak and roasted cabbage between plates. Top steak with mushrooms and enjoy!

name: Grilled Ribeye Steak Salad with Pear, Blue Cheese & Cranberries
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
When the grill pan is hot, coat with oil.
Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large salad bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, quarter, core, and thinly slice the pear; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash the spring mix (skip if it came pre-washed), and add to the bowl with the dressing and pears. Toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide the salad between plates; top with steak, blue cheese, and cranberries. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Romaine Steak Salad with Celery & Dill-Blue Cheese Dressing
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the dill in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the dill along with yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices. Whisk until smooth.
Add blue cheese to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, trim and quarter romaine head lengthwise into wedges. Rub cut sides with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Place romaine quarters, cut-side down, on the pan. Cook, turning halfway through, until charred and leaves begin to wilt, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to another plate.
Meanwhile, trim and medium dice celery.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide romaine between plates, arranging it grilled-side up. Top with steak, dressing, celery, and reserved dill. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon with Eggplant, Tomato, Yogurt Sauce, Basil & Pine Nuts
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan is heating, trim and slice eggplant lengthwise into ½-inch thick planks; transfer to a plate, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt.
Once the pan is hot, add eggplant and grill, flipping once, until tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Add yogurt, water, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels, place on another plate, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the eggplant is done, coat the pan with oil; add salmon and grill until flakey and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the salmon is cooking, thinly slice tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide salmon, eggplant, and tomato slices between plates. Top veggies with yogurt sauce and pine nuts, then sprinkle basil over top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon Kabobs with Peach & Tomato Panzanella Salad
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board.
