Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Cut the salmon crosswise into 1-inch strips and transfer to a medium bowl; season with oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Drizzle oil over both sides of the bread. Once the grill is hot, add bread and grill until charred marks appear, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool. (Leave the grill on for the salmon.)
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice the shallot; add to another medium bowl.
Add vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the shallot; stir together.
Thread one strip of salmon onto each skewer and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the salmon directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.

Coat the grill or skillet with oil; place kabobs on the grill, rotating every 1½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil. Work in batches if necessary.
Meanwhile, tear the bread into bite-sized pieces. Halve the tomatoes and add both to the bowl with the shallots.
Halve peaches, twist to open, and remove pits. Slice each half into wedges and add to the bowl with the tomatoes and bread.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide salmon kabobs and panzanella salad between dishes. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon Salad with Goat Cheese, Walnuts & Strawberry Dressing
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and thinly slice the strawberries; place in a small saucepan, reserving a small handful for garnish.

Add vinegar, honey, and Dijon to the saucepan; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until berries have softened and mixture thickens, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, coat with oil. Add salmon and cook until opaque, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, zest the lemon.
Add lemon zest, salt, pepper, and water to the saucepan with the strawberries and remove from the heat.
Using a hand or regular blender, purée the dressing until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tbsp at a time, to reach drizzling consistency.
Cut lemon into wedges and set aside.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, divide the spinach between plates. Top with grilled salmon, walnuts, goat cheese, and reserved strawberries. Place lemon wedges on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Sausage Tacos with Spicy Charred Pepper & Pineapple Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds. Place in a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; add to the bowl. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat.
Working in batches if necessary, place veggies on the grill. Cook until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side. Return grilled veggies to the bowl and set aside.
Place sausages on the grill and reduce heat to medium. Cook, turning occasionally, until sausages are cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, small dice grilled bell pepper, jalapeño, and half of the green onions (set aside the other half for garnish). Return chopped veggies to the bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice half the lime into the bowl and stir to combine the salsa. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Meanwhile, slice sausages into ½-inch thick rounds, at an angle.
To serve, fill tortillas with sausage, salsa, and whole grilled green onion. Divide tacos and lime wedges between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallop Salad with Mango, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Vinaigrette
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a blender.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add leaves to the blender with the lime juice.
Peel and roughly chop garlic. Add to the blender along with oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth; set dressing aside.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into thin matchsticks. Add to the bowl with the mango.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Meanwhile, pat scallops dry with paper towels and thread onto the skewers so that they lie flat; place on a plate. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides. (Alternatively, you can cook the scallops directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the grill pan is hot, add skewers and cook, flipping once, until scallops are lightly charred and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
To serve, divide salad between plates; top with cashews and grilled scallops. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallop Tacos with Wilted Cabbage, Guacamole & Pineapple Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve and pit avocado. Scoop out into a small bowl and mash with a fork.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the avocado.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the avocado; add salt, stir to combine the guacamole, and set aside. (Reserve remaining lime for the salsa.)
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and small dice. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; place both in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the pineapple and bell pepper.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.
Juice remaining lime into the bowl; add salt, stir to combine the pineapple salsa, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, quarter the cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin strips.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add cabbage and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes. Transfer cabbage to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve pan for the next step).
While the cabbage is cooking, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; rub with oil and season with spices on both sides.
Return pan to medium-high heat. Add scallops in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, add to the plate with the cabbage.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, spread tortillas with guacamole and top with scallops (cutting them in half if necessary); garnish with wilted cabbage and pineapple salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallops with Corn, Lime and Avocado Salad
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Lightly oil grates or pan. Remove husks and silks from corn. Grill corn, turning occasionally until corn begins to char (8-10 min). Set aside to cool.
While the corn cooks, peel and finely chop the shallot. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice the lime into the medium bowl; add olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper and stir to combine.

Pat scallops dry with paper towel.   (If using an outdoor grill, thread scallops, side by side onto skewers so that scallops lie flat.) Drizzle scallops with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Grill scallops until grill marks appear, about 2-3 minutes; flip and cook other side, about 2 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Working one ear at a time, hold the corn vertically inside a large bowl and slice the kernels away from the cob; discard the cob. Add the kernels to the salad dressing.
Halve the avocado and remove pit. Thinly slice the flesh while still in the skin and then scoop out the slices using a spoon.
To serve, toss lettuce with corn mixture and avocado, arrange on a plate and top with grilled scallops. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp, Onion & Tomato Pizza with Lemon-Parsley Mixed Greens
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Transfer shrimp to a plate; drizzle with oil and season with spices on both sides, then set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and cut onion lengthwise into 1-inch wide wedges.
Once the grill pan is hot, add shrimp and onion; cook, turning occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through and onion is tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Juice lemon into the bowl, then add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve tomatoes.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan; top with grilled shrimp and onion, tomatoes, and feta. Sprinkle with oregano and crushed red pepper.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the cheese starts to melt, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizza and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp & Pineapple Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing
ingredients: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Place spices in another medium bowl and stir to combine.
Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces; transfer to the bowl with the spice mix.

Add shrimp to the bowl with the pineapple, toss to coat, then thread shrimp and pineapple onto the skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the shrimp and pineapple directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers to the grill and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and the shrimp are cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Trim and slice the cucumber into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with skewers. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp Tacos with Mango-Avocado Salsa
ingredients: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a paper towel or clean cloth and pat dry. Transfer to a medium bowl. If using fresh shrimp, place them directly into a medium bowl.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the shrimp and transfer the rest to a medium bowl (for the salsa).
Drizzle the shrimp with olive oil and season with chili powder; toss to combine. Set aside while you prepare the salsa.
Peel the mango and discard the peels; slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice the mango and add to the cilantro.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh from the skin. Small dice the avocado and add to the bowl.
Halve the jalapeño lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Juice the lime and pour over the salsa. Toss the salsa until well combined.
Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the shrimp; cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel or cloth and microwave until they are heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Once the shrimp have cooled slightly, peel and discard the tails.
To serve, place 3 to 4 shrimp into each tortilla and spoon the mango-avocado salsa over top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Pineapple, Carrot, Cilantro & Broccoli Slaw
ingredients: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; core and small dice. Add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine the coleslaw and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and coleslaw between plates or bowls; enjoy!

name: Grilled Spicy Asian Pork Skewers with Pineapple Salsa & Cabbage Slaw
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and slice lengthwise into thick planks. Place planks on a plate, then drizzle with oil and season with salt on both sides.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor skillet, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add the pineapple planks and grill, turning occasionally, until tender and charred in spots, about 8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Thread pork onto skewers and place on another plate. Alternatively, you can cook the pork pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Return the pan to medium-high heat; add the pork skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the pork is charred and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot, then add fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Small dice pineapple, return to the plate, and drizzle with half of the dressing. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for the next step.)
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the reserved dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
Divide skewers and slaw between plates. Serve with pineapple salsa on the side and enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Carrots with Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Wash carrots. Halve crosswise then halve or quarter lengthwise. Transfer to a medium bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with parsley flakes, salt, and pepper.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash and chop chives.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Once steak has been transferred, place carrots on grill/skillet. Cook until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes per side.
Add broth, oil, garlic, chives, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
To serve, arrange steak, carrots, and mashed potatoes on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Greek Salad Lettuce Wraps with Garlicky Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then slice against the grain into ¼-inch thick strips. Transfer steak to a small bowl, pour half of the dressing over the steak, and turn to coat. Set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Transfer to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Medium dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes. Roughly chop olives. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the steak strips and cook to desired doneness, about 1 minute per side for medium-rare. Transfer to a plate.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with Greek salad, steak, and feta. Serve with yogurt sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak with Green Bean & Grape Tomato Salad
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Peel and finely dice the shallot. Grate zest from the lemon. In a large bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the shallot, lemon zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash the green beans, trim ends, and halve.

Add the green beans to the boiling water and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to prevent further cooking. Set aside to drain and cool.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat the grill or skillet with oil. Add the steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash the tomatoes and parsley. Halve the tomatoes and add to the dressing. Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to the bowl.
Add the green beans to the bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, place the steak and salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak with Mango Salsa & Spinach-Tomato Salad
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together olive oil, lime juice, honey, salt, and pepper.
Season steak with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash mango and jalapeño. Peel the mango, slice flesh away from the pit, small dice, and transfer to a medium bowl. Seed, mince, and add jalapeño to bowl. Peel, small dice, and add onion to bowl.
Add lime juice, honey, and salt to salsa; mix to combine.
Wash and dry spinach. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash and halve tomatoes. Add to bowl with spinach.
Place steak on a plate and top with mango salsa. Add salad on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Mushroom Salad with Parmesan & Creamy Garlic Dressing
ingredients: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 2-4 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, place mushrooms in a medium bowl. Add Worcestershire and spices, then toss to coat. Thread mushrooms onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the mushrooms directly on the grill pan.)

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add mushroom skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and tender, about 10 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a clean medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Place on another plate, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad, steak, and mushrooms between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Onion Salad with Spicy Jalapeño-Pineapple Salsa
ingredients: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut skin off pineapple; quarter, core, and slice into ½-inch thick planks. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into half-moons; add to the bowl with the pineapple. Drizzle with oil and toss to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add pineapple and onions. Grill, turning once, until charred and tender, about 4 minutes; remove to a plate. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in the reserved bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl, then add oil, vinegar, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
Transfer the grilled pineapple to a cutting board and roughly chop. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine the salsa, and set aside.
Return grill pan to medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to the plate with the onions and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide lettuce between plates or bowls; top with steak, onions, and pineapple salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak with Strawberry Panzanella Salad
instructions: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat. Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Cube bread.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add to grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Coat bottom of sauté pan with oil. Add bread cubes and, stirring occasionally, toast until golden brown, 4-5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.

Wash and dry strawberries, cucumber, and basil. Trim stem ends, quarter, and add strawberries to bowl with dressing. Medium dice and add cucumber to bowl. Pick basil leaves off the stems; roll them up crosswise, thinly slice into ribbons, and add to bowl.
Add bread cubes to bowl and toss to mix.
To serve, place salad on a plate and crumble with goat cheese over top. Serve with steak on the side. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak with Tomato, Corn & Avocado Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise, then remove and discard the pit. Scoop out and medium dice the flesh; add to the bowl.
Cut the jalapeño pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions crosswise on an angle into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Juice the lime and pour over the salad.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Place the steak on a plate and season with salt and pepper on both sides; set aside.
Shuck the corn to remove the leaves and silk threads.
Place the corn on the grill pan / skillet. Cook, turning frequently, until it is softened and lightly charred, 3 to 4 minutes in total. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
Once the corn has been transferred, coat the bottom of the grill pan / skillet with coconut oil.
Place the steak in the grill pan / skillet; cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the steak cooks, stand the corn vertically and slice off the kernels; add them to the bowl with the other salad ingredients.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and cumin; toss to combine.
To serve, place the steak and salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Vegetables with Chimichurri Sauce
instructions: Wash zucchini, bell pepper, and carrots. Slice zucchini diagonally into rounds. Seed and cut pepper into 8 strips. Peel, halve crosswise, then halve or quarter carrots lengthwise.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Transfer vegetables to a large bowl. Drizzle with oil and season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add vegetables to grill/skillet and cook until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side.

Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
To serve, place steak and vegetables on a plate and drizzle with chimichurri sauce. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Thai Chicken with Cucumber Peach Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate the zest from the lime, juice the lime; add both to a medium bowl.
Peel and grate the fresh ginger and add to the medium bowl.
Add fish sauce, maple syrup, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl. Whisk the dressing together and pour half of it into a salad bowl and put to the side.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the medium bowl and toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through (about 4-6 minutes per side). Discard any remaining marinade.
To the remaining dressing (in the salad bowl) add salt, water, and olive oil and whisk together.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges and add to the salad bowl.
Trim the ends of the cucumber, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice into half rounds, and add to salad bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and tear the leaves into small pieces. Roughly chop the peanuts. Add everything to salad bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Tofu & Broccoli Skewers with Creamy Chickpea Salad
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place mayo, Dijon, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; small dice stems. Place florets in another medium bowl and set aside for the skewers. Add stems to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea salad. Set aside.
Large dice tofu and add to the bowl with the broccoli florets. Drizzle with soy sauce and oil, then season with spices. Gently toss to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, thread tofu and broccoli onto skewers, alternating ingredients, and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the tofu and broccoli directly on the grill pan.)
Once the pan is hot, add skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until tofu is warmed through and broccoli is tender-crisp, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chickpea salad and tofu-broccoli skewers between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Turmeric Chicken with Minty Cucumber-Avocado Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, cumin, salt, and pepper. Transfer half of the yogurt mixture to another medium bowl.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board; cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
Place the chicken in one of the bowls and coat in the yogurt mixture; set aside for 15 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the cucumber ends; small dice the cucumber and add to the other bowl of yogurt.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and discard the skins. Small dice the flesh and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan/skillet heats up, pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss the salad until well combined.
Transfer the chicken to a plate, wiping off excess marinade.
Coat the grill pan or skillet with coconut oil.
Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until cooked through and golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Divide the chicken and cucumber-avocado salad between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: Grilled Vegetable Pasta Salad with Herbs & Goat Cheese
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and transfer to a large bowl.
Quarter tomatoes and add to the bowl with the asparagus.
Peel and thinly slice onion into rings. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add veggies in a single layer. Cook until tender and charred, turning occasionally, 6-8 minutes. Return grilled veggies to the bowl and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the veggies have cooled slightly, cut into bite-sized pieces and return to the bowl. Add dressing and herbs; toss to combine.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Crumble cheese and add to the bowl; toss gently to combine.
To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls and enjoy!

name: Grilled Veggie Sausage & Bell Peppers with Creamy Dill Potato Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and quarter bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, add peppers (reserve bowl for the next step) and cook, turning occasionally, until soft, 7-8 minutes. Transfer peppers to a plate and cover with aluminum foil (reserve grill pan for later use).
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.

Return grill pan to medium heat. Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
When the potatoes are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add potatoes to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; stir to combine the potato salad.
Slice cooked peppers into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide potato salad, peppers, and sausages between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Zucchini & Veggie Wraps with Garlic Hummus
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim ends and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and thinly slice onion into rings; add to the bowl with the zucchini. Add oil and salt; toss to coat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the veggies and cook until tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return veggies to the bowl and cover with foil.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; transfer to a blender.
Peel garlic and add to the blender.

Juice lemon into the blender. Add water, oil, tahini, paprika, and salt. Blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Add more water, one tbsp at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency. Set aside.
Thinly slice tomato into rounds.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread evenly with hummus. Divide zucchini, onion, tomato, and lettuce between them; roll tightly to close.

Return grill pan to medium-high heat. Once the grill pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Place wraps on the grill and cook, rotating every 1-2 minutes, until tortillas are crispy and golden. Cut each wrap in half.
To serve, divide wraps between plates and enjoy!

name: Ground Beef, Bell Pepper & Green Bean Chili with Yogurt
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans; cut the beans into ½-inch pieces and transfer to a medium bowl.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane, then small dice the pepper. Add to the bowl with the beans.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Add coconut oil to the saucepan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the ground beef to the saucepan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving the juices in the saucepan.
Once the beef has been transferred, add all of the vegetables to the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 5 to 7 minutes.
Return the beef to the saucepan and season with chili powder, salt, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes to the saucepan; bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 5 to 10 minutes.
While the chili cooks, trim and discard the root ends of the green onions; chop the onions into ¼-inch pieces. Stir the white parts into the chili and transfer the green parts to a small bowl.
To serve, spoon the chili into a bowl, add dollops of yogurt over top, and sprinkle with the green onions. Enjoy!

name: Ground Beef, Green Bean & Bell Pepper Stir Fry with Jasmine Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low and cover. Cook the rice until the liquid is absorbed, 12 to 15 minutes. Once done, remove the saucepan from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans; cut the beans in half and transfer to a medium bowl.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Thinly slice the pepper into strips and add to the bowl with the green beans.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and transfer the leaves to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving juices in the skillet.

Once the beef has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the garlic, bell pepper, and green beans. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, juice the lime into a small bowl, then add soy sauce, fish sauce, and whisk together.
Return the beef to the skillet, pour in the sauce, and season with black pepper; stir to combine.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the basil leaves.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place the rice onto a plate and top with the stir fry. Enjoy!

name: Ground Beef, Kale & Carrot Stir Fry with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a large bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the grated cauliflower to the skillet and season with salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Once done, return back to the bowl.

While the cauliflower cooks, fold the kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Roughly chop the leaves and transfer to a medium bowl. Cut the stems into ½-inch pieces and transfer to a separate medium bowl.
Trim and discard the ends and peel the carrot; julienne or coarsely grate the carrot and add to the bowl of kale stems.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the ginger; add to the bowl.

Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions on an angle into ¼-inch pieces. Add all the white parts and about ½ of the greens to the other vegetables and transfer the rest to a small bowl for later.
Once the cauliflower has been transferred, increase the heat to medium and add more coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the kale stems, carrots, garlic, and ginger; cook, stirring regularly, until the vegetables soften, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the kale leaves and drizzle with soy sauce and rice vinegar; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is wilted, 2 to 3 minutes.
Divide the cauliflower rice between two bowls (or one bowl and one lunch container), top with the stir fry, and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Ground Beef & Mixed Veggie Skillet with Mashed Potato Topping
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beef and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until just browned, 3-4 minutes.
While the beef cooks, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
When the beef is done, add veggies and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add milk, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
When the veggies are soft, add flour and cook, stirring frequently, 1 minute more.
Add tomato sauce, broth, peas, and Worcestershire to the skillet; stir to combine the beef filling and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat.
Spoon mashed potatoes over the beef filling; using a fork, evenly spread mashed potatoes over the top, creating ridges.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Ground Chicken Wrap with Sautéed Bell Peppers & Apple-Cilantro Slaw
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers, chicken, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the slaw; set aside.
When the chicken is done, place tortillas on a flat surface, then divide chicken and peppers between them. Top with apple slaw, roll tightly to close, and cut in half.
To serve, divide chicken wraps between plates and enjoy!

name: Ground Pork, Brussels Sprout & Mushroom Sauté with Poached Egg
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts; place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the Brussels sprouts; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

While the pork is cooking, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add vinegar, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the water in the pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low.
When the pork is done, reduce heat to medium. Add Brussels sprouts, mushrooms, water, and Dijon to the skillet; stir to combine, cover, and cook, undisturbed, until veggies are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, gently crack eggs into small bowls.

Adjust the heat of the saucepan as necessary so that the water is simmering. Gently tip bowls into the pan, sliding the eggs carefully into the water. Cook until whites are set but yolks are still soft, 2½-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer eggs to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the eggs are poaching, mince the chives.
To serve, divide pork and veggie sauté between plates or bowls. Top with a poached egg, season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle with chives. Enjoy!

name: Ground Turkey & Chickpea Curry with Basmati Rice
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash and small dice tomatoes. Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add ground turkey and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Return pan to stove and add onion. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; place on paper towels and pat dry.
Add curry powder to the onion and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Return turkey to pan. Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing); stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and cook until liquid thickens, 4-5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place rice on a plate, top with curry, and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Ground Turkey, Potatoes & Peas with Crusty Bread
instructions: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add ground turkey and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash, peel, and large dice potato. Wash and medium dice tomato. Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Measure out peas.

Add potato, tomato, ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing), frozen peas, tomato sauce, oregano, cumin, and salt; stir well. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until potato is tender, 15-20 minutes.
Toast bread.
To serve, place in a bowl and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Hawaiian Beef & Pineapple Chili with Spinach & Avocado
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl of onion.

Cut off and discard the skin of the pineapple; halve or quarter the pineapple lengthwise and cut off and discard the core from the pieces. Cut the flesh into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a medium bowl.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and ground beef to the saucepan; cook, breaking apart the meat into smaller pieces, until the beef is browned and the onion is tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
Season the beef with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add almost all of the pineapple (save a few pieces for garnishing) and diced tomatoes to the saucepan; stir to combine.
Increase the heat and bring the chili to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 10 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and discard the skins. Medium dice the flesh and transfer to a small bowl.
Stir the spinach into the chili until it wilts.
Divide the chili between two bowls (or one bowl and one lunch container) and garnish with the remaining pineapple and avocado chunks. Enjoy!

name: Hawaiian Pork Burger with Citrus Grilled Pineapple, Zucchini & Onion
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and cut crosswise into 1-inch rounds. Peel, halve, and cut onion lengthwise into 1-inch wide wedges; place both in a medium bowl.

Cut off skin from pineapple, halve, and remove the core. Cut a portion of the pineapple into 4 thin slices to place on top of the burgers; set aside for serving. Large dice remaining pineapple and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Zest lime into the bowl with the veggies and pineapple (set lime aside for later); drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine.
Thread veggies and pineapple onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the veggies and pineapple directly on the grill pan. (Reserve the bowl for later use.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the veggies are charred and tender, 4-5 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger; place both in the reserved bowl.
Add pork, bread crumbs, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic and ginger; use your hands to thoroughly combine. Form into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.

When the skewers are done, coat the grill with oil. Place burger patties on the grill and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, cut reserved lime into wedges.
Toast buns on the grill (if desired).
Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with a pork burger and two slices of pineapple. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and skewers between plates. Squeeze lime over the skewers and enjoy!

name: Hearty Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili with Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash and medium dice sweet potatoes (without peeling).
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and potatoes. Stirring frequently, cook until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once onion is softened, add garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to saucepan. Stir and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add broth and tomatoes; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook chili until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans; add to saucepan while the chili is simmering.

Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ¾ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to saucepan; stir to combine. Continue cooking until potatoes are tender.
Serve chili in a bowl and garnish with dollops of yogurt and remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Herb Crusted Salmon with Arugula & Roasted Tomato Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Using the back of a spoon, rub salmon filets with Dijon mustard and place in the middle of the pan.
Place grape tomatoes on either side of the salmon filets. Drizzle tomatoes with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grate the zest from the lemon into a small bowl. Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add parsley almond meal, salt, and pepper to the lemon zest and stir to combine.
Top salmon with herb mixture and press so that the crumb adheres to the salmon. Place in the oven to bake for 8-10 minutes or until the salmon is nearly opaque.
While salmon cooks, make the dressing. Juice the lemon into a medium bowl; add olive oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt and pepper, whisk to combine. Add arugula to the bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, put salad on plates and top with roasted tomatoes and salmon filet. Enjoy!

name: Herbed Salmon with Roasted Green Beans & Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Spread out evenly and place in the oven. Tossing once halfway through, roast until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.
Wash and remove leaves from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets.
Once water in saucepan is boiling, add cauliflower. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until very tender, 12-15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Season salmon fillet with salt, pepper, and parsley flakes.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add salmon and cook until opaque, 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain cauliflower and return to saucepan. Add oil, parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
Cut lemon into wedges.
To serve, place cauliflower mash on a plate, add salmon on top, and have green beans on the side. Garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Honey-Butter Gnocchi with Prosciutto, Broccoli, Peas & Parmesan
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove prosciutto to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic.
Wash and dry broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add butter, garlic, broccoli, salt, and red pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan, place in a small bowl, and set aside.
Add gnocchi, peas, and hot water (from the tap) to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the water reduces and gnocchi are soft, 3-4 minutes more.
While the gnocchi is cooking, crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the skillet. Add honey and stir to combine; remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi and vegetables between bowls. Top with crispy prosciutto and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Honey-Dijon Arugula Salad with Chicken, Potato, Pear & Goat Cheese
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter potatoes and transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan. Drizzle potatoes with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Place cutlets on the other side of the baking sheet; drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing potatoes and flipping chicken halfway through, until cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pear; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and set aside.
When the chicken and potatoes are done, transfer chicken to a cutting board and slice into thin strips.
Add roast potatoes and arugula to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken. Enjoy!

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Drumsticks with Spinach, Avocado & Orange Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Using a paper towel, lightly coat a small baking dish with oil.
Add chicken to the dish, place in the oven, and bake for 10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ⅔ of the garlic (save the rest for dressing), soy sauce, honey, and parsley flakes. Set aside.

Wash, dry and transfer spinach to a large bowl. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out, medium dice, and add to bowl. Wash, peel, and quarter orange. Slice 3 of the quarters (save 1 for the dressing) into wedges and add to bowl. Toss salad.
Remove dish from oven, pour honey garlic sauce over drumsticks and turn to coat. Place back in the oven and bake until cooked through, another 20-25 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together juice of remaining orange, remaining garlic, oil, salt, and pepper.
To serve, place drumsticks on a plate, add salad on the side, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Honey Mustard Chicken Salad with Strawberries, Avocado & Corn
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, place mayo, honey, water, Dijon, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and thinly slice strawberries; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice green onions; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with chicken and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Honey Mustard Chicken Tenders with Broccoli Orange Slaw
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Using a paper towel, lightly coat a small baking dish with oil.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan. In a small bowl, mix together Parmesan, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, and paprika.
In a different small bowl, mix together Dijon, honey, and oil.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Cut each fillet into strips.
One by one, dip chicken strips in mustard mixture, then coat in bread crumb mixture, and place in baking dish.
Place in the oven and bake, turning over halfway through, until tenders are golden brown, 15-20 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the slaw), Dijon, and honey. Set aside.
In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper.
Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing. Wash, peel, and medium dice orange. Add to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place chicken tenders and broccoli slaw on a plate and have honey mustard sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Honey Mustard Lamb Chops with Mushrooms & Green Beans
instructions: Wash and dry the mushrooms and beans. Thinly slice the mushrooms.
Peel and mince the garlic and place in a small bowl; add Dijon, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper and whisk to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a separate bowl, toss lamb chops in half the honey mustard sauce. Reserve the remaining, untouched sauce for later.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the lamb chops in the skillet; cook until they are nicely seared and cooked to your desired doneness, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chops to a plate and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Return the skillet to the heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms soften, 4-5 min.
Meanwhile, trim and discard the ends of the green beans.
Add beans to the skillet and continue to cook until beans are tender crisp, 2-3 min.
Add remaining, untouched sauce to the skillet with the veggies and cook until heated through, stirring frequently, 1 min more.
To serve, divide lamb chops between plates, arrange veggies on the side drizzling with any sauce remaining in the pan. Enjoy!

name: Honey-Soy Glazed Salmon with Sautéed Bok Choy & Basmati Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a small bowl, whisk together ½ of the garlic and ginger (save the rest for the bok choy), lemon juice, soy sauce, and honey.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Place salmon in a baking dish and spoon ½ of the sauce over top.
Place in the oven and bake, spooning remaining sauce over top halfway through, until salmon is opaque, 12-15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash bok choy, trim ends, and separate into leaves.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining garlic and ginger and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add bok choy and soy sauce. Tossing occasionally, cook until greens are just wilted and stalks are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange salmon, rice, and bok choy on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp with Broccoli & Rice
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, garlic powder, chili-garlic sauce, and honey. Set the sauce aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add broccoli and walnuts to the skillet and stir-fry until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes. Remove from skillet and place in the bowl with the sauce.
Return the skillet to medium heat.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer shrimp to the bowl with the broccoli and sauce. Stir to combine.
To serve, divide the rice, shrimp, and broccoli between bowls and garnish with crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Hot Gingered Beef & Broccoli Salad with Red Pepper
ingredients: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; place both in a medium bowl.
Add oils, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Slice the steak into thin strips and place in another medium bowl. Add ⅓ of the dressing and toss to coat; set aside to marinate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add broccoli to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until bright green and almost cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add steak strips and marinade to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until desired doneness, 2-3 minutes for medium. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips.
Add bell pepper and mixed greens to the bowl with the remaining dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with steak-broccoli stir-fry and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Hot Honey Chicken Tenders & Blue Cheese Wedge Salad with Herby Ranch
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the coating.
Place mayo, soy sauce, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and toss to coat.
Add bread crumb coating to the bowl with the chicken and toss well to coat. Transfer coated chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. (Reserve small bowl for later use.)
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place honey, hot sauce, and salt in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the hot honey and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a blender.
Using a clean cutting board, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add half to the blender along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Blend on high until herby ranch dressing is smooth; set aside. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Trim and cut romaine in half lengthwise, to make 2 wedges.
Halve grape tomatoes lengthwise. Season with salt.
Divide chicken tenders and romaine wedges between plates. Top wedges with dressing, tomatoes, blue cheese, and remaining chives. Serve with hot honey for dipping chicken. Enjoy!

name: Hot Honey Wings with Celery, Carrot, Radish & Blue Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place honey and hot sauce in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the hot honey and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in another medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and trim carrots; run the peeler along each carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with blue cheese, and gently toss to combine the salad.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven and add to the bowl with the hot honey. Toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Hot Italian Sausage Sandwich with Peppers, Onions & Mozzarella
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place sausages on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); bake for 8-10 minutes while you prepare the veggies.
Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed and slice into thin strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; transfer both to the bowl with the peppers.
Add oil, salt, and Italian seasoning to the bowl with the veggies; toss to combine.

Remove baking sheet pan from the oven, flip sausages, and push them to one side. Add veggie mixture to the pan and return to the oven; continue to bake until veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, pour tomato sauce into the bowl used for the veggies. Add spices and stir to combine; set aside.
Grate cheese.
When the sausages and veggies are done, remove from the oven; set oven temperature to broil on high.
Split the rolls in half and place on another baking sheet pan, cut-side facing up. Place in the oven and broil until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, slice sausages in half crosswise.

Set the tops of the rolls aside, leaving the bottoms on the baking sheet pan. Sprinkle the bottoms with half of the cheese. Divide veggies, sauce, and sausages between the rolls and top with remaining cheese. Place in the oven and broil to melt the cheese, about 1 minute.
Close sandwiches and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Hummus Plate with Roasted Asparagus, Pita Chips, Carrot Salad & Feta
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus, then cut in half crosswise. Transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan.

Place the pita on a flat surface. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 2-inch pieces and place on the other half of the baking sheet pan.
Grate zest from the lemon and transfer to a small bowl. Add oil and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the herb oil.

Spoon the herb oil over the asparagus and pita. Toss the asparagus and pita with your hands, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until the asparagus is cooked through and pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the beans. Measure out a ¼ cup of beans and set aside in a small bowl.
Peel the garlic. Add garlic and remaining beans to a blender.

Juice half of the lemon into the blender. Add water, oil, tahini, and spices, then blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Add more water, one tbsp at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency. Set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl. Add maple syrup and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine.
Peel and trim carrot; using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrot and place in the bowl with the lemon dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Trim cucumber and slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

To serve, divide hummus between bowls or plates; garnish with reserved beans and drizzle with oil. Arrange the asparagus, pita chips, carrot salad, sliced cucumber, and feta around the hummus. Sprinkle parsley over top and enjoy!

name: Indian-Inspired Beef Kheema with Peas & Basmati Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice the tomato; transfer to a small bowl.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a small bowl.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, peel and mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl of ginger.
Add curry powder to the bowl of ginger and garlic.
Add the spice mixture to the onions; cook, stirring constantly, for about 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking apart into smaller pieces, until browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the tomato, water and season with salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop the leaves.
Add the peas and half of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir to combine and cook until the peas are warmed through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Divide the rice between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container), top with the beef kheema, and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Indian Potato-Cauliflower Curry (Aloo Gobi) with Cucumber Raita & Naan
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off leaves from the cauliflower, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, onion, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice potato; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Add spices to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add cauliflower, potato, tomato, and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 15-18 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the curry cooks, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl (reserving the rest for the curry).
Trim and grate cucumber into the bowl with the cilantro; add yogurt, water, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the raita and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Arrange naan on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven; broil, flipping once, until golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven, spread with oil, and cut into quarters.
When the curry is done, stir in reserved cilantro and remove from the heat.
Divide curry between bowls; serve with raita and naan on the side. Enjoy!

name: Indian-Spiced Grilled Cheese with Carrot Chutney & Apricot-Mint Salad
ingredients: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place in a small saucepan.

Add water, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the pan with the carrot. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until carrots are soft and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 10 minutes. Remove chutney from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into thin slices and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining mint for the sandwiches.)
Slice mozzarella into thin rounds.
When the carrot chutney is done, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Layer mozzarella, chutney, and reserved mint over half of the slices, then cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more oil to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and apricots, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Indian Spiced Lentil Soup with Sweet Potato, Spinach & Pita
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince the garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer.
Add ginger and spices to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth, water, salt and pepper to the pan; bring the mixture to a boil.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the sweet potato; add to the pan.
Trim and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower and cut into small, bite-sized pieces; add to the pan.
Stir to combine the soup, then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Cut pita into wedges.
Uncover the soup and stir in the spinach. Cook until spinach is wilted and soup is heated through, about 2 more minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and serve with pita on the side. Enjoy!

name: Indian Spiced Potato Pockets with Mint Raita & Cilantro Chutney
