Pick the basil leaves off the stems and slice into ribbons.

Shake the zucchini noodles in the colander over the sink to remove excess water; transfer the noodles to the centre of a clean towel and wring over the sink to remove as much moisture as possible (you should squeeze out at least ½ a cup).
Add zucchini to the bowl with the dressing and toss until coated with dressing.
To serve, arrange zucchini noodles on a plate and top with walnuts and teaspoon sized scoops of ricotta cheese. Sprinkle with basil ribbons and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Herb Chicken over Warm Vegetable Primavera Rice Salad
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl, then set lemon aside for later use.

Add peas to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are warm and veggies are tender-crisp, 2 minutes more. Return veggies to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Chop chives into small pieces. Add both to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with salt, and stir to combine the herb mix. Set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, half of the herb mix (reserving the rest for the rice salad), salt, and pepper. Sauté, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, transfer cooked rice and remaining herb mix to the bowl with the veggies. Juice lemon into the bowl, drizzle with oil, and stir to combine the rice salad.
To serve, divide warm rice salad and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Herb Pork Chop with Feta & Greek Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add oil and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place in a small baking dish. Pour marinade over the chops, turn to coat, and set aside. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
While the chops are marinating, peel and mince additional garlic; place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Thinly slice olives and add to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add chops and marinade; pan-fry until golden brown on one side, 3-4 minutes.

Flip chops and sprinkle the top side with half of the feta (reserve remaining feta for the salad). Continue to pan-fry until cheese has softened and chops are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chops and salad between plates; top salad with reserved feta and enjoy!

name: Lemon Oregano Chicken, Feta Mashed Potatoes & Cucumber-Tomato Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and chop potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Add to the saucepan and cook until very tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle chicken with oil and season with spices on both sides; arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chicken for 5 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice lemon.

Remove baking sheet from the oven. Using tongs, flip the chicken and place a lemon slice on top of each thigh. Return to the oven and continue to broil until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the potatoes are tender, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add feta, milk, oil, and spices; blend or mash until smooth.
To serve, divide chicken, salad, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Oregano Salmon with Greek Spinach-Rice (Spanakorizo) &  Tzatziki
ingredients: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and quarter the cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Roughly chop the spinach. Add spinach to the saucepan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

Using a strainer, rinse rice under cold, running water, then drain and add to the saucepan with the spinach. Add half the dill (reserving the rest for the tzatziki), broth, salt, and pepper; stir to combine, then scrape down the edges of the pan to submerge the rice. Bring to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes (the rice should resemble a saucy risotto). Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place the salmon, skin-side down, on a baking sheet pan. Rub with oil and season with spices on both sides.
Trim, halve, and slice lemon into thin half-moons. Arrange lemon slices over the salmon, place in the oven, and bake until flakey and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the reserved dill, along with yogurt, pepper, and salt; stir to combine.
Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the sliced cucumber. Add cucumber to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine the tzatziki; set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. When the spinach-rice is done, add half of the Parmesan to the pan and stir to combine. Set remaining Parmesan aside for garnish.
To serve, divide spinach-rice, salmon, and tzatziki between plates. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan over the spinach-rice and enjoy!

name: Lemon Pepper Steak with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes; add to saucepan. Once boiling, cook until potatoes are tender, 10-12 minutes.

Peel and mince garlic. Grate 1 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by mixing together ¼ of the garlic (save the rest for the green beans), lemon zest, lemon juice, oil, oregano, pepper, and salt.
Place steak in bowl and coat with marinade.
Wash green beans and trim ends.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat and add coconut oil. Add remaining garlic and crushed red pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add green beans to the sauté pan and, stirring occasionally, cook until tender crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Drain potatoes and return back to saucepan. Add parsley, chicken broth, oil, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
Remove beans from heat. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
To serve, arrange steak, mashed potatoes and green beans on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Soy Steak with Asparagus, Mushrooms, Ginger & Sesame Seeds
ingredients: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with soy sauce, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Add steak to the bowl with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Slice mushrooms into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the baking sheet with the asparagus.
Peel and mince ginger and additional garlic; sprinkle over the veggies.
Drizzle veggies with oil and soy sauce; sprinkle with sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the steak and marinade; pan-fry until steak reaches desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let rest 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide veggies and steak between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Tahini Chicken Thighs with Tomato, Cucumber & Feta Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the lemon seasoning. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, transfer to the baking sheet, and sprinkle with lemon seasoning on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into the small reserved bowl. Juice the remaining lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide parsley between the two bowls, then set the medium bowl aside for later use.
Add tahini, water, vinegar, and spices to the small bowl. Whisk to combine the lemon-tahini sauce and set aside.
Add oil, additional vinegar, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl, along with the feta, and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Drizzle chicken with lemon-tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Thyme Roasted Chicken & Leeks over Mashed Butternut Squash
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems and place leaves in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the thyme; add honey and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the marinade, and turn to coat; set aside.

Trim off the root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit.
Slice leeks crosswise into 4-inch pieces. Transfer to a baking dish and arrange side-by-side, cut-side down.
Cut butter into small pieces.
Arrange chicken on top of the leeks, pouring any leftover marinade on top. Sprinkle butter over leeks and chicken, then season with additional salt and pepper.
Place baking dish in the oven and roast, turning chicken halfway through, until leeks are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Place squash in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until squash is fork-tender, 12-14 minutes.
When the squash is done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan; add cream, salt, and pepper. Using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
To serve, divide mashed butternut squash, roasted leeks, and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Chicken Thighs with Charred Scallion Dressing & Grilled Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the lemon seasoning. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with lemon seasoning on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Place on a plate.
Halve and pit avocado. Add to the plate with the zucchini.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim green onions and add to the plate. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add the green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the plate.
Place zucchini on the pan. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, roughly chop ⅓ of the green onions. Place in the reserved bowl. (Set remainder aside for serving.)

Juice half of the reserved lemon into the bowl with the onions (set remaining lemon aside for the veggies). Add yogurt and spices, then stir to combine. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
When the zucchini is done, place avocado, cut-side down, on the pan. Grill until charred on the cut-side and warmed through, 1-2 minutes per side; return to the plate.
When the avocado is done, squeeze the reserved lemon over the veggies, then drizzle with additional oil.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; drizzle dressing over chicken. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Pasta Primavera with Chicken, Asparagus & Peas
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the asparagus.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season generously with salt and pepper.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander, reserving ½ cup of the cooking water.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.

Once the chicken has been transferred, add more butter to the skillet followed by the asparagus, garlic, and peas; season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing frequently, until the asparagus is bright green and just tender, 4 to 6 minutes.
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl. Add the yogurt and stir to combine.
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to the bowl with the Parmesan, then juice the lemon into the same bowl; stir to combine.

To the asparagus and peas, add the cooked pasta, butter, Parmesan mixture, and half of the reserved pasta water. Cook, tossing constantly, until the mixture is well combined, 2 to 3 minutes. (If the sauce is dry, gradually add the remaining pasta cooking water to achieve your desired consistency.)
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the pasta between plates and top with the chicken slices. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Tuna, White Bean & Sweet Pepper Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a small bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl. Peel and mince (or press) the garlic; add to bowl with the lemon.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice and whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Drain the tuna and transfer to a large salad bowl; flake with a fork. Place the spinach in the bowl with the tuna.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Medium dice the pepper and add to the bowl with the spinach.
Remove the root ends from the green onions and cut them crosswise, into ¼ inch pieces at an angle; add them to the salad bowl.
Halve the tomatoes and add them to the salad bowl as well.
Add beans to the salad bowl along with the dressing; toss to coat.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh and cut into slices; set aside.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with avocado slices. Enjoy!

name: Lemony White Bean-Arugula Salad with Prosciutto & Homemade Croutons
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bread cubes to the skillet and season with spices. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until croutons are golden brown, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a large bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans, then add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan.
To serve, divide salad between plates. Top with croutons and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Lemony White Bean Spinach Salad Topped with Feta & Pistachios
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and thinly slice the carrots at an angle.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the carrots and cook until fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water and set aside.
Meanwhile, zest half the lemon into a medium bowl, then juice the whole lemon into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl, stirring to combine.
Halve and pit the avocado; cut the flesh into cubes while still in the skin and scoop out into the bowl.
Drain and rinse the beans in the colander with the carrots, then add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop the pistachios.
To serve, divide spinach between plates, layer with vegetable-bean salad and top with feta cheese and pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Lentil-Arugula Salad with Beets, Oranges, Pine Nuts & Goat Cheese
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
While the lentils are cooking, zest half of the oranges into a medium bowl (reserve oranges for later use).
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the orange zest along with vinegar, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from reserved oranges; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, and add to the bowl with the orange segments.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with roasted beets, pine nuts, and goat cheese. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Goat Cheese Tartines with Warm Tomato-Dressed Spinach Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; halve grape tomatoes. Transfer both to a small baking dish, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tomatoes have softened and released their juices, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons. Peel and mince additional garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with vinegar and spices; stir to combine.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Slice sun-dried tomatoes into thin strips and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and set aside.
When the roasted tomatoes are done, add cream to the baking dish, and stir to combine the warm tomato dressing. Set aside.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander. Add to the bowl with the goat cheese mixture and stir until creamy and combined.
Toast bread in the oven or toaster (if desired). Divide lentil mixture between bread slices, spreading it out in an even layer.
To serve, divide lentil tartines and spinach between plates. Spoon the warm tomato dressing over the spinach and enjoy!

name: Lentil & Mushroom Sloppy Joes with Avocado-Spinach Salad
ingredients: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince onion and garlic; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Roughly chop mushrooms. Trim, seed, and roughly chop pepper. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add vegetables, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.

Add tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl with the dressing. Add spinach and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
When the lentils are tender, drain, and add to the skillet with the vegetables; stir to combine the sloppy joe mix.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with sloppy joe mix and close with top half of the bun. Divide salad between plates and enjoy!

name: Lentil, Peach & Greens Salad with Goat Cheese & Walnuts
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Rinse the lentils, then transfer to a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 2 inches; bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl (that will be used to prepare the dressing).

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the lentils until they are just tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain in a colander, rinse under cold water, and set aside to cool and drain further.
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together and set aside.
Transfer the greens to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Roughly chop the walnuts and add to the salad bowl.
Crumble the goat cheese with your hands and place in a small bowl.
Once drained, add the lentils to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls, top with the goat cheese, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Lentil, Sweet Potato & Kale Salad with Feta
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Rinse the lentils, then transfer to a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 2 inches; season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the lemon juice.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the lentils until they are just tender, 15 to 18 minutes. Drain in a colander, then set aside to cool and drain further.
To the lemon juice and garlic, add olive oil, Dijon, maple syrup, cumin, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the shallot cooks, peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes.
Add the sweet potatoes to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
While the potatoes cook, cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves into 1-inch pieces.
Add the kale to the skillet; cook, tossing with the potatoes, until it is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Transfer the feta to a small bowl.
Transfer the potatoes and kale to a large salad bowl.
Add the lentils to the salad bowl. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between dishes and top with the feta. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Taco Lettuce Wraps with Sautéed Veggies & Lime Crema
instructions: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until the lentils are just tender, 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Seed bell pepper, slice into thin strips. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat. Add onions, bell peppers, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 8 minutes.
Quarter tomatoes and set aside.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise and then lengthwise to form cubes while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Set aside.
Finely chop walnuts and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the walnuts.
Add oil, water, and spices to the bowl.
Add the cooked lentils to the bowl and stir until well combined.
To make the crema, juice the lime into a small bowl; add mayo and whisk to combine.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with lentil taco "meat", veggies, cilantro, and crema. Enjoy!

name: Lentil, Tomato & Mixed Greens Salad with Avocado & Garlic Bread
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender 15-20 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together ¾ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad), oil, and Italian seasoning.
Place buns or rolls cut side up in a small baking dish. Spoon olive oil and garlic mixture on the bread.
Place in the oven and bake until bread is crusty, 10-12 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry greens. Wash, dry, and cut tomato into wedges. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice. Wash, trim root ends, and chop green onions. Transfer everything to a large bowl.
Drain lentils and add to bowl. Toss salad.
To serve, place salad on a plate, drizzle with dressing, and have with garlic bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Lentil-Walnut "Bolognese" Fettuccine with Artichoke Mixed Greens
ingredients: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Medium dice tomato; add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add tomato sauce, water, lentils, and walnuts to the pan; stir to combine the bolognese. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft, about 18 minutes.

While the bolognese is cooking, fill another medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta in a colander.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in the reserved bowl. Add mayo, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the lentils are soft, use a potato masher to mash the bolognese until semi-smooth, about 1 minute.
Add drained pasta and half of the parsley to the pan with the bolognese, then toss to combine; remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta and salad between plates; top pasta with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Lentils with Cauliflower, Carrots, Caper-Anchovy Salsa Verde & Feta
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower.

Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet along with whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
While the lentils are cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Mince anchovy fillet and capers. Add both to the bowl with the parsley along with additional oil, vinegar, and pepper; set aside.
When the lentils are done, drain and return to the pan. Cover and set aside.

When the veggies are done, carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Mash with a fork, add to the bowl with the parsley mixture, and stir to combine the salsa verde.
Add half of the salsa verde to the pan with the lentils. Stir to combine. (Reserve remaining salsa verde for serving.)
To serve, divide lentils between plates or bowls; top with the veggies, feta, and reserved salsa verde. Enjoy!

name: Lettuce Wrap Burgers with Fresh Greens & Paprika Aioli
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl.
Juice half of the lemon into the bowl with the zest. Add mayo and spices; whisk to combine the aioli and set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium salad bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Form the ground beef into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, coat with oil.
Place the burger patties in the grill pan and cook, undisturbed, for 3 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, seed and slice the bell pepper into thin strips; add to the salad bowl.
Halve the tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside two large leaves per burger; chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with a burger patty and a spoonful of aioli. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Linguini with Tofu, Fresh Tomato Sauce, Zucchini, Basil & Parmesan
ingredients: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu to the skillet and sprinkle with spices; cook, turning often, until golden on all sides, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
When the tofu is done, remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat and add more oil, swirling to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 15 seconds.
Add tomatoes, zucchini, broth, Italian seasoning, and salt to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until zucchini is soft and sauce has thickened, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Cut lemon into wedges; set both aside.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add zucchini-tomato sauce and tofu to the pan; gently toss to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates; top with Parmesan, basil, and a squeeze of lemon. Enjoy!

name: Mango, Avocado & Arugula Salad with Cilantro-Lime Dressing
instructions: In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lime juice, olive oil, honey, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to dressing and mix. Set aside.
Wash and dry arugula.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Wash and peel mango; slice flesh away from pit and medium dice. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
To serve, arrange a bed of arugula on a plate and top with onion, avocado, and mango. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Mango, Avocado & Bacon Salad with Lemony Chive Dressing
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, finely dice chives. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Place frozen edamame in a medium bowl, cover with hot water (from the tap), and let sit 5 minutes. Drain in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice the lemon into the bowl with the chives.
Add mayonnaise and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Once the bacon is cooked transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and pat to remove excess oil. Crumble or chop into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the salad bowl.
Peel mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Slice the mango and add to the bowl.
Add edamame to the bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle dressing over salad and enjoy!

name: Mango-Avocado Quinoa Bowl with Black Beans
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and water; bring to a boil over high heat.
Drain and rinse the black beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Juice the lime and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and small dice the flesh into ¼-inch cubes. Add to the salad bowl.
Remove the pit from the avocado with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh into ¼-inch cubes. Add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the black beans and cook until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange the quinoa, black beans, and mango-avocado mixture in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Mango Chicken Curry with Bell Pepper & Basmati Rice
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Large dice the pepper into ¾-inch cubes. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and large dice the flesh into ¾-inch cubes. Transfer to a small bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
To the ginger and garlic, add curry powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is browned but not cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the bell pepper and onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the spice mixture to the pan; stir until fragrant and well combined, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the coconut milk and mango to the pan; bring to a boil.

Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer. Add the chicken and about ¾ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls, top with the curry, and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Manhattan Fish Chowder with Halibut & Crusty Bread
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Halve the carrot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick half-rounds and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; slice it crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick pieces and add to the bowl.
Preheat a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the carrots and celery.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened, 5 to 6 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the saucepan.
Peel and medium dice the potato.
Grate all the zest from the lemon into a small bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl.

Add the diced potatoes, diced tomatoes, broth, lemon zest and juice to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 10 to 12 minutes.
One by one, holding a sprig of thyme at its top, run your fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves; add to the saucepan.
Cut the fish into 1-inch pieces.
Add the fish to the soup and season with additional salt and pepper. Cook until the fish is opaque and cooked through, another 4 to 5 minutes.
Slice the buns in half and toast if desired.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and serve with the bun on the side. Enjoy!

name: Maple Balsamic Steak with Pear, Arugula & Goat Cheese Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Transfer ½ to a small bowl.
Place steak in medium bowl and turn to coat.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, core, and cut pear into thin wedges. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add pear and onion slices; cook until lightly browned and tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add steak to grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash and dry arugula. Add to bowl with pear and onion and toss.
Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, place steak and salad on a plate, sprinkle with goat cheese, and drizzle with remaining sauce. Enjoy!

name: Maple Dijon Bacon-Wrapped Salmon with Roasted Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup).
Wash and dry asparagus. Snap (or cut) off woody ends and arrange on one half of the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; set aside.
Place maple syrup and Dijon in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on the cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin). Discard the skin.
Cut salmon into portions. Spread half of the sauce over the salmon, then wrap with bacon. Spread remaining sauce over the bacon, then arrange, seam-side down, on the prepared baking sheet.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through and asparagus is tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer asparagus to a plate; cover with aluminum foil.
Change the oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Return salmon to the oven and broil until bacon is crispy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide salmon and asparagus between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Dijon Chicken Drumsticks with Lemony Dill, Kale & Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a baking dish; whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the baking dish with the marinade, and turn to coat.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage the greens with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
To serve, divide chicken and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple Dijon Chicken with Mushroom & Quinoa Risotto
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, broth, and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Place chicken thighs in a baking dish.

Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the mushrooms), maple syrup, Dijon, vinegar, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Pour over top chicken and turn to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Scoop sauce over chicken halfway though.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with rosemary, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until tender, 3-5 minutes.
Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Add broth to mushrooms and cook until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes. Add spinach and stir until wilted. Then stir in quinoa and Parmesan.
To serve, place risotto on a plate and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Dijon Pork Chops with Acorn Squash & Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry acorn squash; halve lengthwise, trim off the ends, then scoop out seeds. Cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick slices and place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and trim Brussels sprouts; halve lengthwise and add to the bowl with the squash.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Drizzle oil over veggies and season with spices; toss to coat.
Transfer veggies to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
While the chops are cooking, place maple syrup, Dijon, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce.
When the chops are done, remove to a clean plate, pour maple-Dijon sauce over top, and turn to coat both sides.
To serve, divide pork chops, sauce, and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple Glazed Salmon with Sugar Snap Pea, Carrot & Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Place salmon fillets in a baking dish and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and broil for 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, maple syrup, Dijon, and pepper.
Take salmon out of the oven and spoon sauce over top. Return to oven and cook until salmon is opaque, another 5-6 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Wash peas and carrot. Halve the peas and add to bowl with dressing. Peel, coarsely grate, and add the carrot to bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place quinoa salad on a plate and add salmon on top. Enjoy!

name: Maple Glazed Tofu with Garlic Sautéed Bok Choy & Basmati Rice
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and large dice tofu; place on paper towels and pat dry.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and, stirring frequently, cook until lightly browned, 5-6 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, whisk together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the bok choy), soy sauce, maple syrup, and rice vinegar.
Add sauce to tofu. Stirring frequently, cook until sauce thickens and coats tofu, 2-3 minutes.
Wash bok choy, trim ends, and separate into leaves.
Transfer tofu and sauce to a plate and return skillet to stove. Add more oil, remaining garlic, and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add bok choy and soy sauce. Tossing occasionally, cook until greens are just wilted and stalks are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange rice, tofu, and bok choy in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Teriyaki Salmon Sushi Bowls with Cucumber & Edamame
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Place maple syrup, soy sauce, oil, vinegar, and garlic powder in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Cut salmon into bite-size pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade and gently toss to coat. Set aside for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry cucumber. Trim and cut into thin sticks.
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
When the salmon is done marinating, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add salmon and all of the marinade. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and salmon is opaque and flaky, 3-5 minutes.
Place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine. When the rice is done, pour the mixture over it and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice between bowls and top with cucumber, edamame, and salmon. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Margherita Portobello Mushroom Pizzas with Bacon
ingredients: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the mushroom caps, then remove and discard the stems. Peel and mince the garlic.
Place the mushrooms on the baking sheet. Rub with olive oil and season with the minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place the mushrooms in the oven and bake for 5 minutes while you prepare the toppings.
Wash the tomato and basil. Slice the tomato horizontally into rounds. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons.
Grate the fresh mozzarella.
Chop or cut the bacon into smaller pieces.

Remove mushrooms from the oven and drain any excess liquid. Sprinkle a little of the mozzarella into each cap, then top with bacon, tomato rounds, and ½ of the basil. Finish off with the remaining mozzarella.
Place in the oven and cook until the mushrooms are tender and the cheese is melted, 15-20 minutes.
Wash the cucumber and grape tomatoes. Quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then chop crosswise. Halve the tomatoes.
To serve, place the mushroom pizzas on a plate and sprinkle with the remaining basil. Serve with grape tomatoes and cucumber on the side and enjoy!

name: Marinated Steak with Crunchy Apple, Walnut & Blue Cheese Salad
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add soy sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Place the steak in the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic; transfer to another medium bowl along with yogurt, blue cheese, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and cut apple into matchsticks, add to the bowl with the romaine, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates. Enjoy!

name: Masala Steak with Cardamom Root Veggies, Goat Cheese & Pistachios
ingredients: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl.
Add goat cheese to the bowl with the basil; set aside to soften.

Peel, trim, and slice carrots and parsnips crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, season with cardamom and salt, then stir to combine. Spread out in an even layer and drizzle with honey.

Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.

Once the pan is hot, coat with butter. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, use the back of a spoon to mash and combine the basil-goat cheese. Set aside.
Roughly chop pistachios.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top veggies with basil-goat cheese and pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Mashed Indian Curry Vegetable Stew with Buttered Rolls (Pav Bhaji)
ingredients: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice potatoes and carrot. Seed and small dice bell pepper. Transfer veggies to a large pot.

Add broth, sugar, and salt to the pot; stir to combine, then scrape down the edges of the pot so that veggies are submerged. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes and carrots are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion (reserving a small handful for garnish) and cook, stirring occasionally, until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the skillet with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring often, until soft and fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Small dice tomatoes.
Add tomatoes, additional broth, peas, tomato paste, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens and peas are heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

Once the potatoes and carrots in the pot are tender, remove from heat. Use a potato masher to gently crush the veggies, forming a textured mash. Transfer the tomato sauce to the pot and mash once more to combine.
Return veggie mash to the stove over medium-high heat. Continue to cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the vegetable mash (reserving a small handful for garnish) and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Toast rolls if desired, and spread with butter.
Divide veggie mash between plates and top with more butter. Serve with onion, cilantro, lime wedges, and buttered rolls. Enjoy!

name: Meatballs & Tomato Sauce with Zucchini Spaghetti
instructions: Peel and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a medium bowl, combine beef, egg, almond meal, ½ of the onion, ½ of the garlic, cumin, basil, salt, pepper, and a ¼ of the minced parsley. Mix together.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Form beef mixture into small balls and place on a plate.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil and add meatballs. Turning occasionally, cook until browned but not cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate once done.
Once meatballs have been transferred, add more oil to skillet. Add remaining onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add remaining garlic and red pepper to skillet and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.

Add tomatoes, remaining parsley, oregano, basil, salt, and pepper. Mash tomatoes with a potato masher. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, add meatballs, and simmer until meatballs are cooked through, 5-10 minutes.
Wash zucchini, trim ends, and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
To serve, place zucchini noodles in a bowl, top with meatballs and sauce, and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Baked Tilapia with Green Beans, Tomatoes & Black Olives
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot; place in a medium bowl along with the oil, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim ends of green beans and arrange them in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet pan. Add tomatoes and drizzle with half the dressing. Reserve the remaining dressing for later.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast 10 minutes, until tomatoes and beans begin to soften.
Pat the tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with pepper on both sides.
Roughly chop the olives.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and toss. Lay the fish on top of the vegetables and return to the oven; bake for 10 minutes, or until tilapia is cooked through.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Change oven setting to broil and cook another 4 minutes, until the fish is slightly golden.
To serve, divide the fish and veggies between plates and top with olives, parsley, feta, and remaining dressing. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chicken & Bread Salad (Fattoush) with Feta Dressing
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Arrange chicken cutlets on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season both sides with spices.
Place chicken on the bottom rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping once, until cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to a clean cutting board, cut each pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into bite-sized pieces, place on a second baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Drizzle oil over the pita and sprinkle with Italian seasoning and salt. Gently toss to combine, then spread back out in an even layer.
Place pita chips on the top rack of the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add yogurt, water, vinegar, sugar, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk until smooth. Add feta and stir to combine the dressing; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice cucumber. Trim and thinly slice radishes. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; shave parsley leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl along with the pita chips and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Spoon dressing on top and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Feta & Tzatziki
ingredients: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl; pour ½ of the juice into the quinoa (save the rest for the tzatziki sauce).
Once the quinoa is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove the saucepan from the heat and let the quinoa stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Small dice a ⅓ of the cucumber and add to the remaining lemon juice; halve the other ⅔ of the cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Add to the tomatoes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chops the leaves. Add to the tomatoes and cucumber.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice and cucumber.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper, then rub with olive oil.
Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean cutting board.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice, cucumber, and garlic; mix together and set aside.
Measure out the olives and add to the vegetables.
Measure out the feta and add to the bowl.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the bowl.
Cut the chicken crosswise into bite-sized strips and add to the bowl. Toss the ingredients until well combined.
To serve, place the quinoa mixture into a bowl and spoon the tzatziki sauce over top. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Peel, medium dice, and add onion to bowl.
Wash and dry tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper. Medium dice tomatoes and cucumber and add to bowl with chickpeas. Seed, medium dice, and add pepper to bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
Add feta to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place salad in a bowl or on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Sandwich with Sprouts, Tomato & Side Salad
ingredients: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with mayo, Dijon, and spices. Whisk until smooth.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the bowl with the mayo dressing. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the chickpea salad, and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop artichokes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Slice tomato into thin rounds.
Toast bread if desired.
Divide the chickpea salad between half of the slices and spread out in an even layer. Layer with tomato and sprouts, then close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread.
Slice sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Lamb Chops with Tomatoes, Bell Pepper, Olives & Feta
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season both sides with spices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add lamb chops and pan-fry until browned, flipping once, 4-6 minutes (the chops will not be cooked all the way through).
While the lamb is cooking, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin wedges.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips.
When the lamb is browned, remove skillet from heat and add the onion and bell pepper, nestling them around the chops.
Place skillet in the oven and roast until the veggies are fork-tender and chops are cooked through, 6-8 minutes more. Remove skillet from the oven.
Meanwhile, halve and slice tomatoes into 1-inch thick wedges; place in a small bowl.
Halve olives and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the chops are done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Add tomatoes, olives, and parsley to the skillet and toss to combine. Return skillet to the oven and roast until tomatoes are warmed through, about 4 minutes. Remove from the oven.
To serve, divide the veggies and lamb chops between plates. Top veggies with feta and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Sweet Potatoes with Chickpeas & Garlic-Yogurt Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and cut sweet potatoes lengthwise into 4-6 wedges each, depending on size, then transfer to the sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread wedges out in an even layer, then place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, until potatoes begin to soften slightly.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl.
Place drained chickpeas in the bowl with the lemon juice; add oil and spices. Toss to coat.

Remove sweet potatoes from the oven and flip using tongs. Sprinkle chickpeas (and any leftover seasoning) over the sweet potatoes in an even layer and return to the oven. Bake until chickpeas become crispy and potatoes can be pierced easily with a fork, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate the zest from remaining half lemon into a small bowl, then juice into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon zest and juice.
Add yogurt and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the sauce. Add 1-2 tablespoons cold water, if needed, to reach drizzling consistency.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide potatoes and chickpeas between plates. Top with tomatoes, parsley, and garlic-yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Halve the grape tomatoes and transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces on an angle and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; halve the celery lengthwise, then slice crosswise at an angle into ¼-inch-thick pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl.
Add the capers to the salad bowl.
Open the tuna cans and drain the liquid; add to the salad bowl.
Transfer the chickpeas to a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk together until well combined.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
To serve, spoon the salad into a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Tuna Stuffed Bell Peppers with Baby Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Wash, halve lengthwise, and seed the bell peppers.
Place the peppers cut-side down on the baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil until the peppers start to soften and brown, 3-4 minutes.
Drain the tuna and transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash and halve the tomatoes; add to the tuna bowl.
Wash and dry the parsley. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl.
Halves the olives and add to the bowl.
Add the capers, feta, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, and pepper to tuna mixture. Mix until well combined.
Remove the peppers from the oven and carefully flip them over. Fill the peppers with the tuna mixture. Return to the oven and broil for another 3-4 minutes.
Wash and dry the spinach.
Cut the remaining piece of lemon into wedges.
Place the stuffed peppers on a plate. Arrange a bed of greens on the side; drizzle with olive oil and squeeze lemon juice over top. Enjoy!

name: Melty Caprese Steak with Butter Lettuce, Bell Pepper & Basil Salad
ingredients: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing. Pour half into a baking dish, then set the bowl aside.
Cut steak into portions, pat dry with paper towels, and add to the baking dish; turn to coat and set aside to marinate.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
When the peppers are done, return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, thinly slice tomato and mozzarella crosswise into rounds.
When the steak is done, remove skillet from heat; top with tomatoes and mozzarella. Cover with a lid and let sit until cheese starts to melt, 2-3 minutes.
While the cheese melts, pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, along with the cooked peppers, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and steaks between plates. Top steaks with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Mexican Chicken Soup with Avocado & Tortilla Crisps
ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Stack the tortillas; cut in half, then cut crosswise into ½-inch-wide strips and transfer to a baking sheet.
Drizzle the tortilla strips with olive oil and season with salt; toss to coat then spread out in a single layer.
Place the tortilla strips in the oven and bake until golden brown and crispy, 6 to 8 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven and transfer to a paper towel lined plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, halve the breasts horizontally to form thin fillets. Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate to cool.
While the chicken cooks, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper to the onion; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the broth, tomatoes, and lime juice to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the soup immediately.
